data.title: IT Operations Engineer
data.description:
We are looking for an IT Operations Engineer to help build, operate, and secure the infrastructure that supports our rapidly growing company.

This is a broad role an early, hyper scaling startup. You will work across enterprise IT, server administration, hosting, DevOps, user support, and information security. The role combines hands-on technical operations with the opportunity to develop robust, well-managed IT environments for engineering, manufacturing, testing, and business operations.

We are looking for someone who understands that reliable IT is essential to a high-performance engineering organisation and that processes and platforms need to be scalable from initial implementation. You should be comfortable working across both Windows and Linux environments, troubleshooting directly, and improving systems rather than simply maintaining them.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Operate and improve IT infrastructure across servers, endpoints, identity systems, Microsoft 365, Exchange, Active Directory, and related services.

  • Manage Windows and Linux systems, including configuration, patching, backups, monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.

  • Support hosting and DevOps activities, including deployments, automation, system reliability, and operational documentation.

  • Manage user access, permissions, devices, software, and IT support requests across the organisation.

  • Help design and maintain secure, segregated, and reliable IT environments for engineering, operations, and business functions.

  • Support IT processes including incident management, change control, asset management, configuration management, and security compliance.

What we are looking for

  • Experience in IT operations, IT support, systems administration, server management, DevOps, hosting, or a similar technical role.

  • Practical experience administering Microsoft environments, including Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Exchange, or comparable services.

  • Experience managing servers and infrastructure in Windows, Linux, data-centre, or hybrid environments.

  • A strong interest in IT security, system reliability, access control, hardening, monitoring, and structured operations.

  • The ability to troubleshoot methodically, document solutions clearly, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical users.

  • A degree, vocational qualification, professional certification, or equivalent practical experience in IT, computer science, systems engineering, or a related field.

Desirable experience/Things you will have the opportunity to support

  • Classified-information requirements such as VS-NfD or higher, BSI IT-Grundschutz, or similar security frameworks.

  • Access and permission management, system hardening, security monitoring, segregated networks, or environments with high protection requirements.

  • BSI-approved cryptography or other regulated information-security requirements.

  • Cloud computing, virtualisation, hypervisors such as Proxmox, virtual machines, Docker, or Kubernetes.

  • Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Ansible or Terraform, together with software-development experience.

  • Enterprise IT tools including mobile-device management, patch management, CMDB, ISMS, monitoring, or hardware and asset-management systems.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

data.title: Account Executive, Southern Europe
data.description:
🏢 Who we are

A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone

We are a software company developing an open source zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company.

Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.

Want to see what we're working on? Check out our GitHub repo at https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird or https://netbird.io/knowledge-hub

✏️ What you will do

As Account Executive for Southern Europe, you'll build NetBird's business in France, Spain, Portugal, Italy and Greece, with France as your anchor market. Many teams in the region already run NetBird through our open source and self-serve products, and you'll turn that adoption into annual cloud and self-hosted enterprise contracts while opening new mid-market and enterprise accounts. You own the full cycle, from first touch to signed contract and expansion. You'll report to our Head of Sales and work closely with our Solutions Engineers, Marketing and Product.

You will:

  • Own the full sales cycle in Southern Europe: prospecting, discovery, demos with a Solutions Engineer, proposals, negotiation and close.

  • Turn open source and self-serve users into paying annual customers, using product usage signals to find the right accounts and the right moment.

  • Run outbound into mid-market and enterprise companies that want to replace legacy VPNs such as OpenVPN, Cisco AnyConnect, Fortinet or GlobalProtect.

  • Sell to technical buyers, from infrastructure and network engineers to security leads, with a clear story on open source, self-hosting and zero trust.

  • Build relationships with MSPs, integrators and resellers across the region.

  • Meet customers on site, at conferences and at meetups, and join the team in Berlin for regular offsites.

  • Keep your forecast and HubSpot data accurate, and bring regional product and pricing feedback back to the team.

  • Shape messaging for French-speaking markets with Marketing, including compliance and data sovereignty topics such as NIS2, GDPR and SecNumCloud.

This is a builder role: you'll be the first person dedicated to the region, with a lot of freedom in how you build it and room to grow as the team expands.

🔎 What we are looking for

We're looking for a French-speaking Account Executive who loves selling technical products and has built a territory from little or nothing. If you've sold commercial open source, developer-led or security products into France and Southern Europe, we'd especially love to hear from you.

Must-Haves

  • 3+ years closing new business as an Account Executive in B2B software, with a track record of hitting quota.

  • Experience selling networking, security, infrastructure or DevOps software, for example VPN, ZTNA or SASE, identity, firewall or cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with an open source, product-led or freemium model, and turning free users into paying customers.

  • Comfortable discussing WireGuard, VPN vs. zero trust, SSO and identity provider integration, Kubernetes and self-hosting with engineers.

  • A structured qualification approach such as MEDDPICC.

  • Native French, and able to run discovery, negotiations and executive meetings in French.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Self-directed and organised when working remotely, and happy to travel regularly across the region and to Berlin.

  • You work AI native. You use AI tools every day, for example to research accounts, prepare discovery calls or draft outreach, and you know where they help and where they don't.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Spanish, Italian or Portuguese.

  • Experience as the first or second Account Executive in a new region at a startup.

  • An existing network of IT and security leaders in France, Spain or Italy.

  • Experience with channel partners, MSPs or public sector procurement.

  • Experience with HubSpot.

🌟 What makes you a great fit

These are the values we work by as a team, and what they mean for this role:

  • Own the outcome: The region is yours. You build your own pipeline, own your number, and fix what's in the way instead of waiting for it to be fixed.

  • Default to candor: You forecast honestly, call out deals that aren't real early, and tell customers clearly what NetBird does and doesn't do.

  • Stay close to the user: You know our product well enough to have credible conversations with engineers, and you bring what customers say back to the team.

😌 What's in it for you

We know that happy and supported team members build the best products. That's why we offer:

  • Competitive compensation including salary and equity.

  • Attractive commission plan with no cap on variable pay.

  • Fully remote within the region (+/-1 Central European Time), with regular time with the team in Berlin.

  • Build a region from day one: real ownership of the territory, and room to grow as we expand our sales team.

  • Close collaboration with our Head of Sales, Solutions Engineers, Marketing and Product.

  • The essentials done well: team lunches, team events, and health and fitness programs (e.g., Wellpass).

If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

data.title: Technical Program Manager (AI/ML)
data.description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a Technical Program Manager with an AI/ML background to join our team in Berlin. You will be a key driver of technical cohesion, bridging the gap between our research and the physical implementation of next-generation materials.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building and executing the program management framework that accelerates AI/ML frontier research and platform capability development, which is critical for translating scientific objectives into real-world, scalable materials breakthroughs.

As a member of our growing team of TPMs, you will work closely with our technical teams on internal initiatives and also manage high-stakes customer projects. Your main focus initially will be coordinating complex technical campaigns in frontier AI/ML research focused on developing novel materials, and over time you will likely get involved in establishing more sophisticated, scalable processes for model development lifecycles.



What You Will Do

Program Leadership & Research Integration

  • Lead internal technical programs across AI/ML model development, frontier research, data workflows, and machine learning infrastructure, acting as the connective tissue between AI researchers and materials scientists.

  • Translate scientific and business objectives into executable plans, aligning commercial, research and engineering teams.

  • Close the loop between experimental results and the AI research cycle, translating lab findings back into the model development process to continuously improve accuracy and accelerate discovery.

  • Own planning and delivery of projects; calculating compute, managing resources & dependencies, mapping out timelines, and managing risks to ensure successful outcomes.

Partner & Customer Collaboration

  • Lead technical programs with industry partners and research institutions, serving as a primary program contact for our external partners during the execution and delivery of projects.

  • Facilitate technical discussions between internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Drive project scoping and proposal writing in collaboration with the Partnerships and technical teams.

  • Manage joint development initiatives and coordinate customer pilot programs from conception through to deployment.

Process & Operations

  • Work closely with the rest of the global TPM team to refine scalable processes.

  • Implement metrics for tracking technical milestones and program outcomes.

  • Coordinate compliance and regulatory considerations across programs.

  • Support intellectual property (IP) and scientific publication processes.

  • Foster interdisciplinary team culture and own change management to successfully scale the organisation.

  • Use data to drive continuous improvements to internal and customer-facing processes.


Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You possess a strong background in AI/ML and/or a related Natural Science field.

  • Proven experience as a Technical Program Manager specifically within the AI/ML domain, including a deep understanding of model architecture, cloud computing best practices and the software development lifecycle.

  • Strong leadership and facilitation capabilities for managing cross-functional teams.

  • The ability to navigate high levels of ambiguity and maintain cohesion across multi-disciplinary teams (AI, Chemistry, and Engineering).

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both highly technical researchers and non-technical partners at varying levels of seniority.

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with comfort navigating ambiguity and changing priorities.



Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Experience with molecular simulation software, quantum chemistry packages, or cheminformatics tools.

  • Practical experience or an academic background in Materials Science, Experimental Chemistry, or Physics.

  • Hands-on experience with high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure or scientific data management.



Additional Considerations

This role will be based in our Berlin office, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations (particularly London or Amsterdam) for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

data.title: Senior Control Systems Engineer – Vehicle Dynamics & Abstraction (m/f/d)
data.description:
We are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer to lead the design and execution of robust control layers across a highly diverse fleet of autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will act as the critical boundary layer to the upper autonomy stack. As the industry transitions toward End-to-End driving models, your primary mandate is to ensure that high-level motion commands are executed sensibly and strictly safeguarded at the physical limits of the vehicle. 

Your designs will address complex, real-world scenarios rather than idealized environments. You will build control architectures that remain robust under severe, highly non-linear real-world conditions. This includes handling sudden tire slip, navigating challenging terrain such as mud, gravel, potholes, and dense vegetation, maintaining stability on steep inclines and side slopes, and delivering predictable tracking despite asymmetric system degradation, such as a damaged mechanics.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Control Architecture Abstraction: Maintain a standardized, platform-agnostic motion command interface that cleanly abstracts underlying mechanical complexity from the planning layers. 

  • Multivariable Control & Allocation: Design and deploy control laws to manage path tracking, velocity execution, and actuator saturation, incorporating data-driven control allocation to dynamically distribute effort across multiple actuators. 

  • System Identification & Modeling: Utilize data-driven system identification techniques to model unknown plant dynamics, latencies, and actuator responses. 

  • Pragmatic Simulation & Verification: Validate control loops rapidly. If filter design and linear/nonlinear analysis indicate a controller will behave, you are empowered to rely on lean, pragmatic subsystem simulations to iterate fast rather than being bottlenecked waiting for massive, full-system high-fidelity simulation runs.

  • Motion Safeguarding: Ensure that incoming motion commands are dynamically evaluated, bounded, and safeguarded against the physical realities and constraints of the vehicle chassis in real time.


What you bring to the team:

  • Experience: Proven professional experience developing and deploying real-time closed-loop control systems. 

  • Linear & Classical Control Design: Deep foundational command of classical control theory, including frequency-domain loop-shaping, stability margin analysis (Bode/Nyquist), and standard state-space design methods (LQR/pole-placement).

  • System Identification & Allocation: Demonstrated experience utilizing system identification methods or empirical frequency response estimation to characterize raw plant dynamics, alongside data-driven control allocation techniques.

  • Nonlinear Control Theory: Strong theoretical and practical foundation in Differential Geometry as applied to nonlinear systems, specifically utilizing Feedback Linearization and Differential Flatness for exact state transformation. 

  • State Estimation: Proficiency in Kalman Filtering for state estimation under non-holonomic constraints. 

  • Implementation & Tooling: High proficiency in either the MATLAB/Simulink, C++, or Python. The core requirement is your ability to translate complex control logic into clean, deterministic execution ready for real-time environments.

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. 

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. 

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. 

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.

data.title: Senior Payload Integration Engineer - UGV Platforms  (m/f/d)
data.description:
Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real-world operations. As Senior Payload Integration Engineer, you will own the payload integration across our UGV platforms: the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration of a wide range of mission payloads into our own Mandrill UGV and partner vehicle platforms. Your goal is a payload-agnostic platform with scalable, reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions, so we can adapt quickly to evolving mission needs without redesigning the vehicle for every new configuration. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You drive the integration architecture end to end, from interface definition through bring-up and commissioning to the point where the complete E/E system is proven to work on the vehicle. You will work at the intersection of vehicle hardware, autonomy and MOSAIC orchestration software, mechanical engineering, suppliers, and manufacturing. 


What is your Day to Day Mission:

Payload Integration Architecture and Ownership

  • Define and own the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration concept for various payloads across our UGV platforms, ensuring scalable and reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions. 

  • Design, specify, and validate payload interfaces: power supply, signal routing, communication interfaces, connectors, mounting concepts, cooling, grounding and shielding, and serviceability. 

  • Enable a payload-flexible vehicle platform that supports a wide range of customer-specific payloads (power profiles, environmental conditions, data interfaces) without major redesigns for every new configuration. 

  • Electrical, Electronic and mechanical Integration

  • Integrate payloads into the vehicle power, network, compute, and control architectures: schematics, harnessing, connectors, fusing, diagnostics, and interface documentation. 

  • Work with vehicle communication buses (CAN, automotive Ethernet) to bring payload data and control interfaces cleanly into the vehicle architecture. 

  • Own the health of the complete E/E system: systematic cross-domain troubleshooting across payload, harness, power, compute, and software. 

  • Drive payload mounting together with internal vehicle teams and external suppliers: brackets, packaging, accessibility, vibration robustness, environmental protection, maintainability, and manufacturability. 

Bring-up, Commissioning and Validation

  • Plan and execute payload bring-up and commissioning on vehicle prototypes and demonstrators: mechanical fitment, electrical integration, software provisioning (flashing, configuration, diagnostics), troubleshooting, and validation up to full system commissioning where the complete E/E system is proven to work. 

  • Define acceptance criteria, build and run system-level test setups, automate recurring integration and regression tests with scripts and test tooling, and support field testing. 

  • Translate integration findings into design improvements for vehicle and payload interfaces, and feed validated test workflows into our CI and test infrastructure together with the HW integration and SW Factory teams. 

  • Work directly with payload suppliers: clarify requirements, review technical documentation, align interface specifications, and drive issue resolution. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Documentation 

  • Create clear interface control documents, integration guides, test reports, lessons learned, and reusable standards for future payload integrations.

What you bring to the team:

  • Engineering degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, vehicle systems, or a comparable technical field. 

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in field robotics, vehicle, or mechatronic system integration; you have brought complex E/E systems to life on real vehicles or machines. 

  • Strong E/E integration expertise: power distribution, signal interfaces, connectors, wiring harnesses, grounding, shielding, diagnostics, and vehicle-level troubleshooting. 

  • Hands-on experience with vehicle communication buses (CAN, ideally CAN-FD or automotive Ethernet), including reading and debugging bus traffic during integration.

  • Practical software skills for integration work: Linux, scripting (e.g. Python or Bash), software provisioning and configuration of embedded devices, and issue tracking tools. You are comfortable automating recurring integration tests. 

  • Experience defining and running validation setups from bench and rig level up to vehicle-level testing, with a quality-first mindset and the discipline to design reliable, repeatable test setups. 

  • Strong integration mindset: systematic in debugging, structured in documentation, and able to turn unclear payload requirements into practical engineering solutions.

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – SAP (m/f/d)
data.description:
About Qorelo

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.


The role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are Qorelo’s technical face at the customer. You run workshops and demos on the customer’s real SAP landscape, get Qorelo connected to their systems and tools, and make sure the platform delivers on their data and their processes. Then you bring what you learned back to our engineers.

You work directly with our engineering team and solution architects, report to Marino, our CTO, and spend a real share of your time with customers, both on site and remotely.

What you will own

  • SAP connectivity. RFC connections, technical users and authorisations. You make the connection work and explain it to Basis and security teams in their language.

  • Workshops and demos on real environments. You run on-site workshops of several hours and show Qorelo on the customer’s own SAP landscape, not a sandbox: their custom code, their processes, their data. You prepare together with sales and our solution architects, and you handle the technical questions in the room.

  • Integrations. You connect the customer’s tools to Qorelo through our existing integrations across the SAP, Atlassian, Microsoft and similar ecosystems, and make sure they work on the customer’s landscape.

  • The feedback loop. What you see at customers (where the product wins, where it falls short, what they asked for) comes back to engineering and product as clear, concrete feedback. You are the engineering team’s eyes and ears at the customer.

What you need

  • 5+ years in technical, customer-facing roles around SAP: technical SAP consultant, solutions or presales engineer, or an engineer who spent much of their time with customers.

  • Solid SAP technical understanding: you know how an SAP landscape fits together (ECC, S/4HANA), what RFC connections, technical users and authorisations are, and what a Basis team will ask you. You do not need to be an ABAP developer.

  • Enough technical depth to set up and troubleshoot a connection with the customer’s IT: credentials, firewalls, proxies, VPN, certificates.

  • Strong presence in the room: you can run a five-hour workshop with consultants, IT leads and process owners, demo live on their system, and keep it on track when something does not work.

  • Real AI curiosity: you use LLM tools yourself and can explain clearly what Qorelo does and where its limits are.

  • Willingness to travel within Europe for on-site demos and workshops.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus for our DACH client base.

 

You might be a fit if

  • You have been the person customers want in the room for the demo, and the one consultants call when the connection does not work.

  • You have worked at an SAP consultancy, system integrator or SAP software vendor and want to be closer to a product.

  • You enjoy a full day of workshops at a customer and can still explain clearly afterwards what worked, what did not and why.

  • You have taken software through an enterprise IT and security onboarding and know why it takes as long as it does.

What we offer

  • Real ownership. Meaningful equity and a direct hand in how Qorelo runs in the field. We are looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked for senior customer-facing technical talent in Berlin.

  • The problems. Fortune 500 and DAX 40 production landscapes, including Mercedes-Benz. You work at the core of SAP systems most engineers never get to touch.

  • The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to our CTO, our founding engineer and our solution architects.

  • 25 days paid vacation + German public holidays.

  • Company offsites with the whole team.

  • An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg – where you work when you are not with customers. The fridge is stocked.

  • Wellhub membership, top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call with Gaspar, our founding engineer (30 min)

  2. Deep dive on your SAP and customer-facing background with Marino, our CTO (60 min)

  3. Practical case: a workshop and live demo simulation with our engineers and solution architects

  4. Offer

How to apply

Send us your CV at

Qorelo is an equal opportunity employer. We make our decisions regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, disability or sexual identity.

data.title: Senior Talent Partner
data.description:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Senior Talent Partner has moved into the Head of People and Talent role, so we're looking for someone to take over day-to-day hiring processes for the whole company. We're growing across every team, and you'll be the person who makes sure each of them gets great people when they need them.

This is a full-cycle role first. You'll own searches end to end, from shaping the brief with a hiring manager to closing the offer. Roughly half your roles will be in engineering and half in other functions, so one week you're calibrating an engineering loop and the next you're hiring for sales or operations. A lot of the people we want aren't looking, so you'll find many of them yourself.

The other part of the job is building a talent community around WunderGraph. We're an open-source company with a real developer community, and hiring should draw on that. Events, content, memes, a community experiment that might not work: you'll have room to try things, and we'd rather you tried.

One thing this isn't - a sales role. We don't need someone to push candidates over the line. We need someone who tells our story honestly and specifically enough that the right people lean in and the wrong ones opt out early. That includes the less glamorous parts, like a small distributed team and meetings that stretch into your evening so we can work with the US.

TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to: Head of People and Talent

  • Collaborates closely with: every hiring manager across engineering and non-engineering teams, plus the CEO, COO, VP of Sales and our engineering principals on key hires

  • Acts as each hiring manager's partner on a search, not an order-taker: shaping the brief, setting the bar together, and holding the process to it

ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are succeeding if:

  • Hiring managers across engineering and non-engineering teams get strong shortlists when they need them, not a quarter later.

  • Regardless of source, the candidates are some of the best talent around, rather than people who happened to apply - and you can recognise the difference.

  • Every search you run has a clear brief, a consistent structured process, and no candidate waiting more than 3 days to hear from us.

  • The people you hire are still here and doing well a year on. We scaled sustainably, not just quickly.

  • A talent community exists around WunderGraph that didn't before: people who know us, follow what we do, and raise their hand when the right role opens.

  • Candidates keep telling us ours is the best hiring process they've been through, including the ones we don't hire. You keep it that way as we hire more.

  • Hiring managers trust your judgement enough to change their minds when you push back on a brief, and leadership trusts the plan because your hiring metrics are clear.

  • Our hiring processes are better because you changed them, not just because you ran them.

ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

Full-cycle recruiting

  • Running multiple searches at once across engineering and non-engineering teams, from intake to accepted offer, prioritised by urgency

  • Running role kickoffs with hiring managers to agree outcomes, competencies and the interview loop

  • Writing job profiles and adverts with the People team, tailored to each audience

  • Pre-screening candidates and sharing shortlists with a clear recommendation

  • Coordinating interviews and running debriefs, with blind scorecards in Ashby before any group discussion

  • Keeping every candidate updated, with no one waiting more than 3 days to hear from us

  • Managing offers and closing candidates honestly, without pressure, ensuring each conversation with the candidates is meaningful and insightful for both us and the candidate.

Sourcing

  • Finding and engaging people who aren't looking, through sourcing, open-source projects, communities, meetups and conferences

  • Headhunting directly for senior and hard-to-fill roles

  • Writing outreach specific enough to each person that they actually reply

  • Keeping warm pipelines for roles we hire repeatedly

Stakeholders and reporting

  • Advising hiring managers on market realities: who's available, what they expect, and what that means for the brief

  • Keeping leadership updated with clear hiring metrics and progress

  • Escalating blockers early, with a proposed fix

Talent community and employer marketing

  • Building a community of people who know WunderGraph before they ever see a job post

  • Running creative, low-budget activity: events, content, community-led hiring, the odd meme that lands

  • Working out what worked, and dropping what didn't

Hiring process

  • Improving our interview loops, tasks and scorecards, including for technical roles

  • Documenting our recruitment workflows so they don't live in one person's head

  • Keeping hiring compliant across the countries we hire in, and handling contracts, background checks and documentation with the People team where needed

  • Keeping our hiring data and Ashby setup useful for planning, not just record-keeping23w

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

  • You've run full-cycle recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles, and can walk through searches you owned from brief to accepted offer.

  • You're a strong sourcer. You find people who aren't looking, and your outreach gets replies because it's written for the person reading it.

You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale.

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You are genuinely excited about what we are building.

Hard Requirements

Standort München: Du arbeitest aus dem Homeoffice und bist in Kanzleien in Bayern und Baden-Württemberg unterwegs – München, Augsburg, Stuttgart. Etwa einmal im Monat kommt das deutsche Sales-Team für zwei Tage in Berlin zusammen.

Zwei Account Executives verkaufen bereits in Deutschland an Steuerkanzleien, du kommst als Nächste:r dazu.

Deine Aufgaben als Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien:

  • Du baust deine Pipeline auf: Rund 50 % kommen aus deinem eigenen Outbound – Cold Outreach, LinkedIn, Empfehlungen, Branchenevents –, die andere Hälfte aus qualifizierten Inbound-Leads. Du bleibst dran, auch wenn die ersten Antworten ein Nein sind.

  • Du führst beratende Discovery-Gespräche mit Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen, verstehst ihre Abläufe mit Mandanten und hinterfragst den Status quo.

  • Du zeigst Pennylane im Kanzleialltag: Demos, die den konkreten Nutzen für Kanzlei und Mandanten zeigen, nicht die Feature-Liste.

  • Du steuerst mehrstufige Deals mit mehreren Entscheider:innen bis zur Unterschrift – inklusive Einwand-Handling und Verhandlung.

  • Du übergibst gewonnene Kanzleien an unser Customer-Success-Team in Berlin, das Onboarding und Betreuung übernimmt, baust dir Promoter-Kanzleien für Empfehlungen auf und hältst Salesforce und Forecast verlässlich aktuell.

Woran du gemessen wirst:

  • Du verantwortest den Umsatz aus Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region – gemessen an neu gewonnenen Kanzleien und an den Mandanten, die über diese Kanzleien aktiv auf Pennylane arbeiten.

  • Du hältst deine Vertriebsziele konstant und baust den Marktanteil von Pennylane im Kanzleisegment deiner Region aus.

  • Du bringst dein Wissen aus dem Markt in Playbook, Produkt-Feedback und die Go-to-Market-Strategie von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im beratenden B2B-Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Lösungen – mehrstufige Deals, mehrere Stakeholder – idealerweise mit SaaS, Kanzleisoftware oder Fintech und gern im Scale-up-Umfeld.

  • Du verkaufst gern persönlich: Kundentermine vor Ort, Kanzleibesuche und Branchenevents in deiner Region gehören für dich dazu – nicht nur Telefon und Video-Call.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem (E-Rechnung, GoBD, Kanzleialltag) – oder bringst die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, hast den Drive, einen neuen Markt aufzubauen, und übernimmst Ownership für deine Zahlen, dein CRM und deinen Prozess.

  • Du hörst aktiv zu, trittst bescheiden auf und baust Vertrauen zu traditionell arbeitenden Kanzleien auf – auf Augenhöhe mit Partner:innen und Steuerberater:innen.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris – und du lebst in Berlin oder im Umkreis und kannst zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt starten.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • 📍 München/Süddeutschland: Homeoffice plus Kundentermine in deiner Region, monatliche Teamtage in Berlin.

  • 🚀 Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – du steigst in der Gründungsphase von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

  • 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

  • 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus ungedeckelter variabler Anteil, der quartalsweise ausgezahlt wird.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget für dein Homeoffice und eine monatliche Pauschale für einen Coworking-Space in deiner Stadt.

  • 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Firms-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

  • 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (alle 3 Monate) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar – plus Team-Events in Berlin.

Vielfalt und Inklusion

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto.   • Du verantwortest den Umsatz aus Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region – gemessen an neu gewonnenen Kanzleien und an den Mandanten, die über diese Kanzleien aktiv auf Pennylane arbeiten.

  • Du hältst deine Vertriebsziele konstant und baust den Marktanteil von Pennylane im Kanzleisegment deiner Region aus.

  • Du bringst dein Wissen aus dem Markt in Playbook, Produkt-Feedback und die Go-to-Market-Strategie von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im beratenden B2B-Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Lösungen – mehrstufige Deals, mehrere Stakeholder – idealerweise mit SaaS, Kanzleisoftware oder Fintech und gern im Scale-up-Umfeld.

  • Du verkaufst gern persönlich: Kundentermine vor Ort, Kanzleibesuche und Branchenevents in deiner Region gehören für dich dazu – nicht nur Telefon und Video-Call.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem (E-Rechnung, GoBD, Kanzleialltag) – oder bringst die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, hast den Drive, einen neuen Markt aufzubauen, und übernimmst Ownership für deine Zahlen, dein CRM und deinen Prozess.

  • Du hörst aktiv zu, trittst bescheiden auf und baust Vertrauen zu traditionell arbeitenden Kanzleien auf – auf Augenhöhe mit Partner:innen und Steuerberater:innen.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris – und du lebst in Berlin oder im Umkreis und kannst zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt starten.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • 📍 Berlin, hybrid: Office in Berlin, Homeoffice und Kundentermine in deiner Region.

  • 🚀 Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – du steigst in der Gründungsphase von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

  • 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

  • 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus ungedeckelter variabler Anteil, der quartalsweise ausgezahlt wird.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget für dein Homeoffice und eine monatliche Pauschale für einen Coworking-Space in deiner Stadt.

  • 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Firms-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

  • 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (alle 3 Monate) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar – plus Team-Events in Berlin.

Vielfalt und Inklusion

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

data.title: Strategic Account Executive - Germany
data.description:
Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit www.saviynt.com.

Saviynt is looking for a professional, highly motivated, and energetic Strategic Account Executive  to drive regional sales for our disruptive IaaS Cloud Security, Access Governance & Privileged Access Mgmt. (PAM) solutions. The Strategic Account Executive will combine a good working knowledge of (IaaS & SaaS) Identity, Cloud Security, or PAM with prospecting and sales skills. You will ultimately be responsible for the entire enterprise sales cycle and meeting or exceeding territory quota. Strategic Account Executives are the primary interface to both Prospects and Customers and are responsible for actively driving and managing day-to-day prospecting and selling activity in the region. This activity includes opportunity Discovery, Demo, RFP/RFI, Evaluation & POC stages of the sales process, and working in conjunction with Sales Engineering & Product Management Teams to identify and close new deals.  This job is located remotely in Germany.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Maintain disciplined, detailed, and up-to-date records on Lead and opportunity activity in SFDC to ensure effective leadership development, proper team communication, and executive visibility.
  • Be diligent in timely follow-up and provide quality work products.
  • Attend and assist with corporate and field sales and marketing events.

  • 7+ years sales experience in enterprise Identity, Cloud Security, or PAM Sales preferred

data.description:

data.title: Senior Development Manager
data.description:
We are looking for a Senior Development Manager to join our Hunt: Showdown team in our state-of-the-art Frankfurt studio. As Senior Development Manager, you will drive the delivery of one or more sub teams, ensuring alignment with Hunt: Showdown’s overall strategy and milestones. You will be responsible for planning, tracking, and improving delivery, implementing the project’s operational model, and fostering an environment of collaboration and excellence across disciplines.

What you'll do
  • Own and drive the delivery of your assigned sub team’s goals, ensuring alignment with project-wide milestones and priorities.
  • Develop detailed delivery plans, schedules, and workflows to meet objectives on time and within budget.
  • Coordinate dependencies and collaboration with other sub teams to ensure smooth integration of work.
  • Implement and maintain the operational model at the sub team level, ensuring consistent processes and efficient workflows.
  • Collaborate with the Development Director on resource and talent planning to meet delivery needs.
  • Foster a healthy and motivated team culture aligned with Crytek’s values and Hunt: Showdown’s creative vision.
  • Anticipate and manage risks, proactively resolving bottlenecks and delivery issues.
  • Ensure deliverables meet agreed quality standards and integrate seamlessly into the project.
  • Maintain transparent communication with stakeholders, providing regular progress updates and reports.
  • Promote operational excellence by identifying process improvements and empowering team members to perform at their best.

    • What you bring
  • 5+ years of experience as a Project Manager, Producer, or Development Manager in game development.
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex, multi-disciplinary projects in a live or AAA development environment.
  • Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Kanban, SAFe, Waterfall) and their practical application at team level.
  • Excellent organizational and leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and align cross-functional teams.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across disciplines and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify risks and drive solutions proactively.
  • Experience with resource planning, scheduling, and task prioritization.
  • Passion for high-quality game development and operational excellence.
  • Fluent English skills and strong interpersonal communication abilities.
  • Willingness to relocate to Frankfurt am Main, Germany.

    • What you can expect from us

    Career Path 
    Your professional development is important to us, so we have laid out a career plan to help you progress towards your goals and objectives. 
     
    Relocation Support 
    We offer a relocation budget and full coverage of flights to Frankfurt for you and your family. 
    You can expect extensive assistance with visa, work permits, and communication with authorities during the relocation process, as well as help settling into Germany (e.g. setting up appointments with banks, government agencies, schools, landlords, finding apartments etc.).
     
    Company Apartment 
    To help you get settled, we provide you with a fully furnished company apartment during your first three months in Frankfurt.
     
    Public Transport Pass 
    Discover Frankfurt by bus, tram and metro – free of charge.
     
    Gym Card 
    A healthy body is a healthy mind. We offer a membership at the premium gym chain Fitness First in Germany. Work out, join group fitness classes, or relax in the wellness facilities.
     
    State-of-the-art Office
    We’ve recently moved into a brand-new, modern office located in the heart of Frankfurt. Our new workspace is designed to inspire creativity and collaboration, with open areas, quiet zones, and top-tier facilities — all just steps away from public transport, restaurants, bars and cultural hotspots.
     
    Hybrid Working
    We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while also supporting flexibility. Our hybrid working model includes three days per week in the office and the option to work remotely up to two days per week, unless role-specific requirements or business needs require you to be on site.
     
    Equal Opportunity & Inclusion
    We’re building a workplace where everyone belongs. We welcome people of all backgrounds and identities and are proud to be a truly global team, with employees from over 42 countries contributing their ideas, cultures, and perspectives every day.
     
    German Classes 
    Understanding the local culture will make your stay abroad more enjoyable, and Crytek supports that by offering German language courses for you and your family. 
      
    Events
    Join us on our exciting company events, including new starter breakfasts, summer and winter parties, our annual trip to Gamescom in Cologne, and many more!
     
    Vacation Days 
    At our Frankfurt office you can enjoy 24 days of vacation per year, and every 2 years you get 1 more (up to a maximum of 28 days). You will also have on average 10 public holidays on top of the days you take off.

data.title: IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) Microsoft 365, Teilzeit oder Vollzeit
data.description:
Über Kigen IT-Systemhaus
Kigen IT-Systemhaus ist ein auf Microsoft 365 und IT-Sicherheit spezialisiertes Unternehmen mit Standorten in Engstingen und Stuttgart. Wir betreuen Unternehmen von der Kanzlei bis zur Unternehmensgruppe und legen Wert auf saubere, sichere IT-Umgebungen. Bei uns gibt es kurze Wege, Vertrauen und echte Weiterentwicklung statt Konzernstrukturen.

Deine Aufgaben
Du bist fester technischer Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden im Raum Stuttgart. Du bearbeitest Support-Anfragen im First und Second Level, richtest Arbeitsplätze, Drucker und Besprechungsräume ein und bist bei Bedarf auch vor Ort beim Kunden. Im laufenden Betrieb verwaltest du Benutzer, Geräte und Lizenzen in Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online und Teams und unterstützt in hybriden Umgebungen mit Active Directory.

Das bringst du mit
Du hast eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker oder vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung und bereits im IT-Support oder in der Administration gearbeitet. Windows Clients und Active Directory sind dir vertraut, Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365 und Intune ist ein Plus. Du hast einen Führerschein und gehst ruhig und freundlich mit Kunden um. Du erfüllst nicht alles? Wenn du motiviert bist, dich einzuarbeiten, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.

Deine ersten Monate
Du lernst unsere Kunden und deren Umgebungen kennen, übernimmst Schritt für Schritt den Support und arbeitest dabei eng mit dem Gründer zusammen. So bekommst du direkten Wissenstransfer, auch in Themen wie Security und Compliance.

Was wir bieten

  • Teilzeit (ab 20 Stunden) oder Vollzeit, ganz wie es zu dir passt

  • Remote-Arbeit, vor Ort nur bei Kundenterminen im Raum Stuttgart

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und moderne Ausstattung

  • Echte Lernkurve in Microsoft 365 und IT-Sicherheit

Vergütung
45.000 bis 55.000 € brutto jährlich bei Vollzeit, je nach Erfahrung. Bei Teilzeit anteilig.

  • Zwei Einstiege: AOI-Prüfung an der Linie oder Programmierung und Prozessoptimierung
  • Gute Basis auch für SMT-Operator:innen mit Erfahrung an Bestückern und Druckern

Deine Aufgaben

  • AOI-Programme neu erstellen, optimieren und bei Änderungen an Baugruppen nachführen
  • AOI-Prüfungen selbstständig durchführen und SMT-bestückte Leiterplatten unter dem Mikroskop kontrollieren
  • Lötstellen und Röntgenbilder nach IPC-Standards beurteilen, Material und Dokumente auf Vollständigkeit prüfen
  • Prüfergebnisse auswerten und Prozesse an der Linie verbessern, um den First Pass Yield zu steigern
  • Scanprogramme aus CAD- und Kundendaten aufbauen und bei Prototypen und Baugruppenanalysen mitarbeiten
  • Produktion bei AOI- und Maschinenproblemen unterstützen und Fehlerursachen nachhaltig beheben
  • Produktionsdaten im MES verfolgen und Änderungen mit NPI, Qualitätsmanagement und IT abstimmen

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung in der Elektronikfertigung, idealerweise in AOI, SMT oder optischer Inspektion
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der Norm IPC-A-610 und ein genauer Blick für Lötstellen
  • Für die Programmierung: IPC-A-610-Zertifikat, auch abgelaufen, und Praxis mit PARMI oder vergleichbaren AOI-Systemen
  • Erfahrung als SMT-Operator:in, zum Beispiel mit SIPLACE oder EKRA, von Vorteil
  • Lötkenntnisse sowie Umgang mit CAD-Daten oder FactoryLogix von Vorteil
  • Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit, hoher Qualitätsanspruch und strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise

Das erwartet dich

  • 40-Stunden-Woche im 2-Schicht-Betrieb, teilweise 3-Schicht
  • Weiterbildungsangebot und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Arbeitsort: Raum Bodensee, Schweiz (vor Ort). Pensum: 100%.

Du bewirbst dich bei CONCAPE GmbH, Personalvermittlung, Städtle 13, 9490 Vaduz, Liechtenstein. Den Namen des Unternehmens besprechen wir persönlich mit dir. Vorgestellt wirst du nur mit deinem OK.

Reporting into the Regional Operations Manager, you will be expected to ensure a high level of service and efficiency is maintained and executed.

Who are Veezu?

Veezu is the UK's fastest growing taxi and private hire technology business operating across hundreds of UK towns and cities. We are a tech-driven on-demand mobility service that supports our hyper-local communities, helping them thrive and so much more!

What you’ll do:

RESPONSIBILITIES - DRIVER PARTNER INTERACTION

  • Champion a “best customer service approach” to Driver Partners.

  • Be the face of Veezu for Driver Partners, being available at the Hub to engage in face-to-face interaction with DPs regarding any issues related to their engagement with VSL. This will include supporting DPs with the uploading of documents to the Driver Partner Portal (or equivalent) when either dealing with new DP engagement or dealing with documentation renewal or changes for existing DPs

  • Verification of DP profile set-up in Cab9.

(e.g. supporting with relevant document uploads, accessing the Driver App and the Driver Partner Portal (or equivalent), handling complaints).

  • Promote the use and functionality of the Driver Partner Portal (or equivalent), knowing how and when to use by and on behalf of DPs.

  • Manage, respond and action all relevant tickets issued via Intercom in a timely manner.

  • Be a champion of the Driver Partner Portal (or equivalent).

RESPONSIBILITIES - VEEZU SERVICES INTERACTION

Continually provide recommendations that are capable of improving service delivery outcomes.

  • Support the Regional Operations Manager with identifying and informing VSL on any DP marketing campaign needs.

LICENSING

  • Investigate and where relevant, assist in complaints received about DPs from passengers, members of the public, local authorities and from other DPs, escalating to the Regional Operations Manager where appropriate. In so doing, ensuring full compliance with the relevant process, tracking and reporting measures in place.

Slingshot AI

Slingshot AI is the team behind Ash, the first AI designed for mental health. Our mission is to make support more accessible and help people change their lives in the ways they want.

Our team spans machine learning, product, engineering, conversational design, clinical, growth, and operations, with offices in both New York City and London.

We're a well-funded Series A company, having raised $93M from Andreessen Horowitz, Radical Ventures, Forerunner Ventures, plus top-tier tech investors involved in ElevenLabs, Captions, Shopify, Plaid, Notion, Canva, Twitch, Airtable, and many others.

Slingshot AI is the team behind Ash, the first AI designed for mental health. Our mission is to make support more accessible and help people change their lives in the ways they want.

Our team spans machine learning, product, engineering, conversational design, clinical, growth, and operations, with offices in both New York City and London.

We're a well-funded Series A company, having raised $93M from Andreessen Horowitz, Radical Ventures, Forerunner Ventures, plus top-tier tech investors involved in ElevenLabs, Captions, Shopify, Plaid, Notion, Canva, Twitch, Airtable, and many others.

The role

As a Member of Technical Staff focused on Machine Learning, you will ship models, training infrastructure, harnesses and evals end-to-end: designing, building, and launching the tech that makes Ash differentiated as a specialized model for mental health, to change a billion minds and lives.

As a core member of a small but highly skilled team, we expect you to act as an owner and to care passionately about delivering value to our users and ultimately to make people's lives better. We are looking for builders who care deeply about the quality of their work and want to ship things that make a real difference in people's lives. We care more about how you think and build than your specific background. If you're a great engineer who's curious about ML, we'd love to hear from you.

We work on a model-agnostic post-training engine running on our own cluster of leased GPUs managed by SkyPilot, trained by an auto-research loop, and evaluated with our home-grown eval index aimed specifically at mental health. We’re constantly improving, and focus on building feedback loops over features, and constantly learning from our production performance, our psych research team, and scalable data sources. Our product tech stack uses Dart/Flutter for the app, Kotlin for core backend services, and Next.js/TypeScript for internal tooling, as well as Rust for low level media streaming. We use gRPC and GCP (Kubernetes, Cloud Run) as our primary cloud provider. You're not required to be an expert in all of these tools, but we would like you to come with a learning mindset and to not be afraid of getting your hands dirty with whatever tool the job might require.

About you

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, owning systems other people rely on.

  • Experience working with LLMs, ideally with fine-tuning, harness engineering, and evals

  • Proficient in using agents to do your homework for you

  • Driven by creating a world-class product with a world-class team, want to own what you build, and you're happy tearing down experiments and features as we learn

  • Experience in a fast-paced startup, or the drive to thrive in one.

  • Collaborative and direct. You enjoy working in person with a small team.

What we offer

  • A chance to join a passionate tight knit team working on something to change the world

  • Competitive compensation (top of personal market) and meaningful equity

  • Travel between our NYC and London offices

  • Usual startup perks like free lunch and coffee in office plus a generous learning budget

  • We cover your personal therapy

Hello, hola, 你好, こんにちは, नमस्ते, hallo, bonjour! Thanks for stopping by — we know your time is valuable, so here's what makes Ultralytics special.

⚡ Who we are
At Ultralytics, we're on a mission to simplify AI for everyone. As the linkcreators of the world's leading Ultralytics YOLO models, we empower millions of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide to build state-of-the-art computer vision applications.

Following our $30M Series A round, we're expanding rapidly across our global hubs. This is an opportunity to join a fast-scaling, high-performance team that's redefining the future of vision AI — where ambition meets impact, and ideas become reality.

We move fast. We build boldly. We execute with purpose. And we do it together.

💼 About the role
As a Solutions Engineer, you'll turn complex computer vision problems into production systems built on YOLO. You'll lead technical discovery, design architectures, build benchmarks and proof-of-concepts, and guide customers from their first conversation to deployed models.

You'll work across Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering while partnering directly with customers in manufacturing, retail, security, robotics, and beyond. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys writing Python, training and optimizing models, deploying across cloud and edge, and owning outcomes throughout the customer lifecycle.

If you thrive on ambiguous problems, direct customer contact, and turning technical possibilities into measurable results, you'll fit right in.

🚀 What you'll do
Technical discovery and solution design

  • Own technical discovery, translate customer needs into architectures, and define measurable success criteria.

  • Evaluate customer data, recommend models, and design training, inference, and deployment strategies.

  • Lead technical qualification and solution design alongside Account Executives and Customer Success Managers.


Prototyping and deployment

  • Build Python prototypes with YOLO, OpenCV, PyTorch, and Docker.

  • Create benchmarks, integrations, and production-ready training and deployment workflows.

  • Deploy solutions across Linux, macOS, Windows, cloud, and edge environments.

  • Diagnose performance, data quality, inference, and hardware acceleration challenges.

Customer engagement and enablement

  • Deliver technical demos, workshops, architecture reviews, and proof-of-concepts that move opportunities forward.

  • Explain machine learning clearly to engineers, operators, executives, and other non-technical audiences.

  • Build trusted relationships and manage technical stakeholders from evaluation through production.


Ecosystem contribution

  • Turn customer solutions into reusable examples, deployment guides, integrations, and documentation.

  • Share feedback with Product and Engineering to improve the YOLO ecosystem.

  • Engage developers through the Ultralytics community and GitHub organization.


📈 What success looks like

  • 3 months: Ramped on the YOLO stack and customers, co-running discovery, and delivering your first demos and project kickoffs.

  • 6 months: Owning technical discovery and POCs end to end, unblocking live deals or at-risk accounts, and earning trust from the AEs and CSMs you support.

  • 9 months: Converting technical evaluations into wins or saves, shipping reusable assets, and providing actionable feedback to the wider organization.

  • 12 months: Becoming the technical partner AEs and CSMs want on their biggest accounts, with POCs that convert and referenceable customer deployments.


🧠 Skills and experience
Core requirements

  • Strong Python and practical experience with YOLO, OpenCV, PyTorch, and computer vision.

  • Experience training, optimizing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models.

  • Comfortable with Docker, Git, REST APIs, Linux, cloud platforms, and edge workflows.

  • Experience deploying across Linux, macOS, and Windows environments.

  • Proven ability to deliver technical demos, workshops, architecture reviews, and POCs.

  • Strong communication skills with both technical and executive audiences.

  • Independent ownership, urgency, resilience, and results in a high-performance startup environment.

  • Passion for AI, open source, and helping customers achieve real outcomes.


Nice to have

  • Kubernetes, CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX, Jetson, or other edge accelerators.

  • Experience with MLOps, model monitoring, CI/CD, or observability.

  • Familiarity with AWS, Azure, GCP, serverless systems, or managed inference platforms.

  • Experience integrating OpenAI or Anthropic APIs into customer tools.

  • Open-source contributions or experience supporting developer communities.

  • Knowledge of Ultralytics YOLO workflows and production computer vision solutions.


🌟 Why this role

  • Real impact: Your solutions will power vision AI in production across systems used by millions of devices.

  • Demand you don't have to manufacture: YOLO is the world's most popular computer vision model, and customers already come to us looking to do more with it.

  • Build at the source: Work directly on top of the YOLO ecosystem with clear lines to Product and Engineering.

  • A team that ships: Join a fast-moving, high-standard team that values results over routine.

  • Customer ownership: Stay involved beyond the demo and see your technical work reach production.


🚫 What this isn't
This isn't a slideware Solutions Engineer role. You won't hand off after the demo or hide behind a deck — you'll build the solution, get it deployed, and own the technical outcome throughout the client lifecycle.

🌟 Cultural fit
At Ultralytics, we set bold goals and execute with speed, precision, and teamwork. We're driven by hard work, ambition, and resilience — building fast, learning constantly, and delivering measurable impact.

You'll thrive here if you:

  • Take ownership and deliver results with focus and accountability.

CAMPAIGN OPERATIONS @ CARWOW

The Campaign Operations team sits at the heart of Carwow’s OEM and Media business. We turn ambitious commercial ideas into high-quality digital advertising campaigns that deliver strong results for our clients and meaningful revenue for Carwow.

We work closely with Sales, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering, editorial and external partners to deliver campaigns across Carwow’s automotive media portfolio. Our mission is to make campaign delivery accurate, efficient and scalable while continuously improving how we work through better processes, technology and innovation.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Campaign Operations Manager, your role will be split roughly equally between two areas: campaign delivery, and ad tech.

Campaign delivery (around 50%): You’ll own the delivery and optimisation of client advertising campaigns across Carwow Studio brands and Carwow. You’ll make sure campaigns launch accurately, perform against their KPIs and give clients an excellent experience after the sale.

Ad tech and data (around 50%): You’ll be the team’s go-to expert for our advertising technology and campaign data. You’ll lead the troubleshooting of ad serving, creative rendering, tracking and data discrepancy issues. You’ll also maintain and improve our ad tech setup and the data flows that power our reporting. Working with Product, Engineering and Data teams, you’ll help develop and integrate new tools, features and automated reporting.

Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality campaigns while building a reliable, efficient and scalable ad tech and data foundation for Campaign Operations. The role offers a clear path to progress to IC4 Campaign Operations Specialist.

 
 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Campaign delivery

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of advertising campaigns across channels, from planning and setup through to optimisation, reporting and post-campaign analysis.

  • Ensure campaigns are implemented accurately, launched on time and delivered in line with agreed objectives and KPIs.

  • Monitor performance and lead optimisation with internal teams and clients to meet and exceed campaign KPIs.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients after the sale, covering campaign performance and technical questions.

  • Produce high-quality reports and post-campaign analysis decks, and present findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients.

  • Identify commercial opportunities, such as upweights, extensions and optimisations, that deliver additional value for clients and Carwow.

Ad tech and data

  • Proactively troubleshoot technical issues across ad serving platforms, creative rendering, campaign tracking and data, minimising delivery and revenue risk.

  • Lead ad tech projects, including implementing new tools, resolving ad server and reporting discrepancies and managing technical integrations.

  • Maintain and improve our ad tech setup and the data flows behind campaign reporting, ensuring accuracy across internal and third-party sources.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering and Data teams to develop and integrate new ad tech features, tools and automated reporting.

  • Drive the adoption of automation, AI and new technology across Campaign Operations while maintaining strong quality-control standards.

  • Continuously review processes to improve efficiency, accuracy and scalability, and share ad tech and data knowledge across the team.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

Proven experience managing and delivering digital advertising campaigns within a publisher, media owner, agency or ad tech environment.

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Google Ad Manager, and experience with a range of creative formats including video, display and HTML5.

  • Confidence troubleshooting technical issues across ad serving, creative rendering, tracking and reporting data.

  • A solid understanding of programmatic advertising, yield management and optimisation techniques.

  • Experience leading or contributing to ad tech or data projects, such as implementing new tools, resolving discrepancies or managing technical integrations.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work across multiple data sources and turn campaign data into clear insights and recommendations.

  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, projects, stakeholders and deadlines at the same time.

  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accurate, high-quality work in setup, troubleshooting and reporting.

  • Confident communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain campaign performance and technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • A commercially minded, collaborative approach and a genuine interest in improving processes through technology, data, automation and AI.

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience in the automotive, publishing or digital media industry.

  • Certifications in Google Ad Manager, Google Ads, programmatic platforms or other ad tech tools.

  • Experience with data and reporting tools such as BigQuery, SQL, Looker or similar.

  • Knowledge of paid social, YouTube, off-site display or demand-generation and lead-generation campaigns.

  • Familiarity with platforms such as DV360, Meta Ads Manager, Salesforce, Driftrock or audience-management platforms.

  • Previous involvement in process-improvement, automation or AI projects.

WHY THIS MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

Campaign Operations is a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, with responsibility for delivering commercially important campaigns against tight deadlines and changing priorities.

You’ll need to be comfortable managing multiple campaigns, taking ownership and proactively identifying potential issues before they affect delivery. You’ll also work closely with different teams to find solutions and should be motivated to challenge and improve existing ways of working not simply follow established processes.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with real influence. You'll partner directly with product and engineering leadership, mentor other designers, and set the standard for how design work gets done at Carwow.

A note on how we work: AI fluency is integral to the role. Our design team works AI-natively. We use Claude Code/Design (and similar tools) to move from idea to high-quality prototype in hours, not weeks, and we expect designers at this level to be genuinely fluent in this way of working, not just curious about it. If you're still designing the way teams did in 2023, this probably isn't the right role. If you've rebuilt your workflow around AI and it's made you dramatically faster and more ambitious, we'd love to talk.
