data.title: Forward Software Engineer
data.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About The Job

As a Forward Software Engineer, you will build the systems behind some of the hardest problems Mistral takes on.

You join our team of engineers in Applied AI. We gravitate towards hard problems, decide how to solve them, and ship fast. You work closely with our customer-facing teams, and what works goes into production with our customers and across the company. When a project needs it, you work directly on customer engagements.

We're looking for a strong software engineer who has shipped agentic or GenAI systems to production. You've felt the pain of agents that work in the demo and fall apart on real tasks: tool calls that fail silently, loops that never end, and quality that drifts after launch. That production depth is your edge. You build across the stack, and you'd rather ship a plain UI on a solid foundation than a polished UI on a fragile one.

You think like a founder. You start from the customer's problem, not the technology. You measure success by the value you deliver, and you care about building experiences people love to use. You like working at the edge of what AI can do today, and you push past it.

Your scope is end to end, from first prototype to production. You help set the standard for how the team builds agents that are reliable, observable, and safe to run against sensitive systems.

Security is a big part of where we're heading. If you're drawn to it, that's a strong plus. You might come from security with a real interest in AI engineering, or from AI engineering with a real interest in security. Both paths fit. Curiosity about how systems break, and a habit of learning fast from the people who know the domain, matter. Experience at a security company counts too.


What you will do

  • Build AI systems end to end, from first prototype to production.

  • Design the agent architecture: orchestration, tool use, memory, retrieval, and the interfaces between agents and the systems they act on.

  • Build across the stack, from backend services and APIs to the interfaces people use to work with agents.

  • Turn what works for one customer into patterns and platforms that work across many, without rebuilding each time.

  • Make systems hold up under real load: throughput, latency, cost, and failure recovery are part of the design from the start.

  • Build security into agents from day one: permissions, sandboxing, prompt-injection defenses, and audit trails for agents that touch sensitive systems.

  • Build the evaluation loop: task-level evals, tracing, and checks that catch agent failures and quality drift before customers do.

  • Work with researchers, engineers, and customer-facing teams to turn hard problems into systems people rely on.


What We're Looking For

  • You have 5+ years building production software, with at least one agentic or GenAI system shipped to production that you ran after launch.

  • You have full ability to ship across the stack: proficient NodeJS e.g. NextJS/Express/Fastify or similar or Python e.g. FastAPI. You are confident with TypeScript + React/NextJS or similar. Solid beats polished.

  • You have hands-on depth in agent design: orchestration, tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and the ways agents fail in the real world.

  • You work autonomously: you find the problem, decide the approach, and own the outcome.

  • You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, and are fluent in English.

  • You ship in increments and are obsessed with time to value

  • You have product judgment: you learn what users need through customer-facing teams, cut scope hard, and care how the result feels to use.

Ideally you have

  • Open-source contributions, particularly in agents or LLMs.

  • Experience deploying and running what you build: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • A security background in application, cloud, or AI security, such as prompt injection, securing agents, or supply chain (SBOM, SLSA). If that's you, flag it in your application.

  • Experience building for security workflows, such as alert triage, threat hunting, or investigation agents, or with SIEM, XDR, or SOAR tooling.


How We Work in Applied AI

  • We care about people and outputs.

  • What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

  • Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.

  • Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

  • We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

  • No politics. Low ego, high standards.

  • We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

The GNC team is growing across Paris and Kyiv. As one of our early GNC engineers, you'll help shape the architecture of our autonomous systems from the earliest design studies through flight testing and final acceptance. We work in short iterations, with a strong culture of experimentation and field validation. Our engineers regularly work alongside operators and end users, ensuring that every algorithm is designed for real operational conditions: not just simulation.

Role & Mission

As a GNC Engineer, you will develop the guidance, navigation, and control capabilities that enable our autonomous platforms to operate reliably in challenging environments. You'll contribute across the entire development lifecycle—from system architecture and flight modelling to live flight testing and operational validation.

We are looking for engineers who enjoy taking ownership of their work, iterating quickly, and seeing their algorithms perform outside the lab.

Guidance, Navigation & Control

  • Design, develop, and improve guidance, navigation, and control algorithms for autonomous aerial systems.

  • Develop and maintain flight dynamics and vehicle models.

  • Contribute to system architecture, control strategies, and performance trade-offs from the earliest design phases.

  • Integrate and tune GNC software on target platforms.

  • Participate in flight-test campaigns and operational demonstrations.

  • Analyze flight data, investigate anomalies, and continuously improve system performance.

  • Work closely with software, AI, systems engineers, test pilots, and operators to validate solutions in real operational conditions.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of professional experience in Guidance, Navigation & Control, flight control, robotics, or autonomous systems.

  • Solid experience in algorithm development with two or more:

    • MATLAB & Simulink

    • Python

    • C/C++

  • Great systems engineering skills. Prior experience with aerospace V&V processes.

  • Motivation to participate in field testing and work directly on deployed systems.

  • Strong analytical skills, engineering rigor, and ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • Embedded software development experience.

  • Experience with open source flight control software stacks.

  • Programming skills in C++ and Python.

  • Experience with UAVs, robotics, or autonomous systems.

  • Familiarity with ROS/ROS2 or real-time embedded systems.

  • Experience with state estimation, sensor fusion, or navigation algorithms.

data.title: CNC Turner / Tourneur CNC
data.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


[Version française plus bas]


You will be responsible for setting up, programming, and operating CNC lathes to manufacture critical aerospace components, including valve parts, pump components, and shafts.

Working from engineering drawings and manufacturing instructions, you will create and adjust programs directly at the machine, select tooling, prepare setups, and perform turning operations. You will machine materials such as stainless steel, aluminium, titanium, and Inconel, ensuring that parts meet dimensional and surface finish requirements.

The role focuses on hands-on machining and programming at the CNC control. English communication skills are expected for everyday exchanges with our international teams.


Your Responsibilities

  • Create, modify, and optimise CNC turning programs directly at the machine.

  • Set up CNC lathes, including workholding, cutting tools, and tool offsets.

  • Perform turning operations independently, from initial setup through to finished parts.

  • Select suitable cutting tools and machining parameters for each material and operation.

  • Manufacture precision components to drawing specifications, including tight tolerances and surface finish requirements.

  • Perform first-piece and in-process inspections using appropriate measuring equipment.

  • Adjust programs, offsets, and cutting parameters to maintain quality throughout production.

  • Use the band saw to prepare raw material when required.

  • Follow manufacturing instructions and record inspection results to maintain traceability.

  • Carry out first-level maintenance and keep machines and workstations clean and organised.

  • Report machining issues and provide practical feedback to the workshop lead and engineering teams.


Your Profile

  • Vocational or technical qualification in machining, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Proven experience as a CNC turner, with the ability to set up machines and program directly at the CNC control.

  • Proficiency in ISO/G-code and/or conversational programming.

  • Ability to read engineering drawings and interpret dimensional tolerances, geometric tolerances, and surface finish requirements.

  • Experience machining stainless steel, aluminium, titanium, or nickel-based alloys.

  • Confidence using precision measuring instruments and checking your own work.

  • Experience with driven tooling and Y-axis operations and mill turn would be an advantage.

  • Autonomous, practical, and quality-focused, with careful attention to detail.

  • Ability to communicate in English with colleagues from other teams.


Why You’ll Love Working With Us?

  • A hands-on role with responsibility for your parts, from setup and programming through to final inspection.

  • Direct involvement in manufacturing components for next-generation space vehicles and propulsion systems.

  • A modern workshop producing varied and technically challenging parts.

  • Opportunities to develop your machining skills within a growing manufacturing team.

  • A multicultural, international team passionate about space exploration.


////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

Vos missions

Vous serez chargé(e) de régler, programmer et conduire des tours à commande numérique pour fabriquer des composants aérospatiaux critiques, notamment des pièces de vannes, des composants de pompes et des arbres.


À partir de plans d’ingénierie et d’instructions de fabrication, vous créerez et ajusterez les programmes directement sur la machine, sélectionnerez l’outillage, préparerez les montages et réaliserez les opérations de tournage. Vous usinerez des matériaux tels que l’acier inoxydable, l’aluminium, le titane et l’Inconel, en veillant à ce que les pièces respectent les exigences dimensionnelles et d’état de surface.


Le poste est centré sur l’usinage et la programmation directement sur la commande numérique. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est attendue pour les échanges quotidiens avec nos équipes internationales.


Vos responsabilités

  • Créer, modifier et optimiser les programmes de tournage CN directement sur la machine.

  • Régler les tours CN, y compris le montage de la pièce, les outils de coupe et les correcteurs d’outils.

  • Réaliser les opérations de tournage de manière autonome, du réglage initial jusqu’à la pièce finie.

  • Choisir les outils de coupe et les paramètres d’usinage adaptés à chaque matériau et à chaque opération.

  • Fabriquer des pièces de précision conformément aux spécifications des plans, y compris des tolérances serrées et des exigences d’état de surface.

  • Effectuer les contrôles de première pièce et en cours de production à l’aide des moyens de mesure appropriés.

  • Ajuster les programmes, les correcteurs et les paramètres de coupe pour maintenir la qualité tout au long de la production.

  • Utiliser la scie à ruban pour préparer la matière brute lorsque nécessaire.

  • Suivre les instructions de fabrication et consigner les résultats de contrôle afin d’assurer la traçabilité.

  • Réaliser la maintenance de premier niveau et maintenir les machines et les postes de travail propres et bien rangés.

  • Signaler les problèmes d’usinage et partager des retours pratiques avec le responsable d’atelier et les équipes d’ingénierie.


Votre profil

  • Formation professionnelle ou technique en usinage, ou expérience pratique équivalente.

  • Expérience avérée en tant que tourneur CN, avec la capacité de régler les machines et de programmer directement sur la commande numérique.

  • Maîtrise de la programmation ISO/code G et/ou de la programmation conversationnelle.

  • Capacité à lire des plans d’ingénierie et à interpréter les tolérances dimensionnelles, les tolérances géométriques et les exigences d’état de surface.

  • Expérience de l’usinage de l’acier inoxydable, de l’aluminium, du titane ou des alliages à base de nickel.

  • Aisance dans l’utilisation d’instruments de mesure de précision et dans le contrôle de son propre travail.

  • Une expérience des outils tournants, des opérations sur axe Y et du tournage-fraisage (mill-turn) serait un atout.

  • Autonome, pragmatique et orienté(e) qualité, avec un grand sens du détail.

  • Capacité à communiquer en anglais avec des collègues d’autres équipes.


Pourquoi vous allez adorer travailler avec nous ?

  • Un poste très opérationnel, avec la responsabilité de vos pièces, du réglage et de la programmation jusqu’au contrôle final.

  • Une implication directe dans la fabrication de composants pour les véhicules spatiaux et les systèmes de propulsion de nouvelle génération.

  • Un atelier moderne produisant des pièces variées et techniquement exigeantes.

  • Des opportunités de développer vos compétences en usinage au sein d’une équipe de fabrication en pleine croissance.

  • Une équipe multiculturelle et internationale, passionnée par l’exploration spatiale.

Why you should join us!

data.title: Welding Engineer
data.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing the technologies and capabilities needed to make space exploration more accessible. We are looking for a Welding Specialist Engineer to support the industrialization and production readiness of our next-generation thruster hardware, including EBW activities, orbital welding and laser-welded components for a high-thrust engine.

This is an intermediate-level engineering role, working closely with and under the technical guidance of our Senior Welding Specialist Engineer. You will support electron beam welding (EBW) for our new thruster, laser-welding activities for a high-thrust engine and participate on the manufacturing of the orbital welding for the our Nyx capsule propulsion.

You will bring practical knowledge and you will work with design, manufacturing, quality and production teams to turn robust welding requirements into repeatable, well-documented manufacturing processes.


What you will do

  • Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of EBW processes for the new thruster and laser-welding processes for our high-thrust engine.

  • Support orbital welding activities (being a qualified welder and support non conformance management).

  • Draft, review and maintain Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS) and related welding documentation; support procedure qualification and qualification records in accordance with applicable NASA requirements and program flow-downs.

  • Support the assessment of weldability, joint design and manufacturing risks, working with design and manufacturing engineering colleagues.

  • Prepare and maintain clear welding documentation, including process records, qualification evidence and traceability information.

  • Help investigate welding non-conformities and manufacturing issues, support root-cause analysis, and follow corrective actions through to closure.

  • Coordinate with qualified welding operators and production teams to ensure that approved procedures are understood and followed; this role focuses on engineering support and does not replace operator qualification or authorization.

  • Apply and develop your knowledge of TIG and plasma welding, including their process capabilities, limitations and quality considerations.

  • Work under the direction of the Senior Welding Specialist Engineer, progressively taking ownership of defined work packages and contributing to technical reviews.

  • Promote safe, disciplined and quality-focused manufacturing practices.


What you bring

  • A degree or equivalent practical experience in welding engineering, materials or manufacturing engineering, metallurgy, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Professional experience in welding or manufacturing engineering, with the ability to contribute independently to defined tasks while seeking guidance on complex or novel issues.

  • Practical knowledge of TIG and plasma welding, with experience or familiarity in laser welding or other precision joining processes.

  • A strong interest in electron beam welding and the ability to support process development, qualification and production-readiness activities.

  • Working knowledge of WPS preparation and control, welding procedure qualification, inspection and traceability; familiarity with NASA qualification requirements applicable to the program is an advantage.

  • The ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications and to produce accurate, structured engineering documentation.

  • A methodical, safety-conscious approach and strong collaboration skills across engineering, quality and production teams.

  • Professional working proficiency in English.


Especially valuable

  • Direct experience with EBW, including process development, qualification or production support.

  • Experience with laser-welding process development, qualification or production support, especially for propulsion hardware; experience with automated TIG or other precision joining processes is also valuable.

  • Experience supporting propulsion hardware, pressure-containing components or other demanding aerospace manufacturing applications.

  • Familiarity with quality-management systems and configuration-controlled manufacturing documentation.

À propos de Dastra

Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la conformité et à la gouvernance de l'IA.

À la croisée du business, de la technologie et du conseil, tu joueras un rôle clé dans nos cycles de vente complexes.

Ta mission : apporter la crédibilité et les preuves techniques qui feront de Dastra la solution de référence pour nos futurs clients.

data.title: Post-doctorant·e en Théorie de l’information quantique des systèmes bosoniques - CDD 24 mois
data.description:
Présentation de Télécom SudParis :

Télécom SudParis est une grande école publique d'ingénieurs reconnue au meilleur niveau des sciences et technologies du numérique. La qualité de ses formations est basée sur l’excellence scientifique de son corps professoral et une pédagogie mettant l’accent sur les projets d’équipes, l’innovation de rupture et l’entreprenariat. Télécom SudParis compte 1 000 étudiantes et étudiants dont 700 élèves ingénieurs et environ de 150 doctorantes et doctorants. Télécom SudParis fait partie de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’école d’ingénieurs en France, et partage son campus avec Institut Mines-Télécom Business School. Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis

À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom

Missions

  1. Assurer des missions de recherche en théorie de l’information quantique, avec un accent particulier sur les systèmes quantiques bosoniques

  2. Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat des étudiants

  3. Contribuer à la notoriété de Télécom SudParis, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris

Activités

  1. Assurer des activités de recherche en théorie de l’information quantique

  • Étudier les propriétés mathématiques et informationnelles des états et canaux quantiques bosoniques, en mettant particulièrement l’accent sur les systèmes non gaussiens.

  • Étudier et chercher à démontrer des inégalités entropiques quantiques intervenant en théorie de l’information quantique bosonique, notamment des inégalités liées à l’action des diviseurs de faisceau et d’autres transformations bosoniques physiquement pertinentes.

  • Développer de nouveaux outils mathématiques pour l’analyse des états et canaux bosoniques non gaussiens, en s’appuyant notamment sur des méthodes issues de la théorie de l’information quantique, de l’analyse matricielle et des opérateurs, de la théorie de la majorisation et de domaines connexes.

  • Appliquer ces résultats à la caractérisation de la transmission de l’information à travers les canaux quantiques bosoniques, en particulier à l’établissement de formules de capacité ainsi que de bornes supérieures ou inférieures sur les capacités de communication.

  • Explorer les liens entre les méthodes développées et d’autres problématiques de la théorie de l’information quantique et de la physique mathématique.

  • Contribuer à la réalisation des objectifs scientifiques et des livrables du projet de recherche.

  • Présenter et discuter les résultats de recherche au sein de l’équipe ainsi qu’avec des collaborateurs extérieurs.

  • Préparer des publications scientifiques présentant les résultats des travaux de recherche.

2. Assurer des activités d’enseignement, d’encadrement et de tutorat

  • Assurer des séances de travaux dirigés dans le cadre d’un cours de théorie de l’information quantique.

  • Préparer et mettre à jour des feuilles d’exercices, des corrigés et d’autres supports pédagogiques pour ce cours.

  • Encadrer des projets étudiants et, le cas échéant, des stages de recherche.

  • Contribuer à l’accompagnement scientifique de doctorants et d’autres jeunes chercheurs travaillant sur des thématiques connexes.

3. Contribuer à la notoriété de Télécom SudParis, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris

  • Publier les résultats des travaux de recherche dans des revues internationales à comité de lecture et dans des actes de conférences.

  • Présenter les résultats de recherche lors de conférences internationales, d’ateliers, de séminaires et de rencontres scientifiques.

  • Participer à des collaborations scientifiques avec des institutions académiques et des centres de recherche en France et à l’étranger.

  • Contribuer à l’animation scientifique et à la visibilité du département et de l’établissement.

4. Activités diverses

  • Participer aux activités scientifiques et académiques du département et de l’établissement.

  • Participer aux séminaires de recherche, aux réunions de projet et aux autres activités scientifiques collectives.

  • Rendre compte de l’avancement et des résultats des activités de recherche dont il ou elle a la charge.

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. data.title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
data.description:
Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit.

The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible.

The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability.

A core scientific challenge is to represent cross-layer trade-offs without hiding their origin: rather than isolated energy or latency numbers, the framework should expose bottlenecks, sensitivities, feasibility limits, break-even points and opportunities and identify the regimes in which a technology becomes advantageous. Target workloads span edge inference through to transformer-inspired models, with use cases in vision, audio and sensor processing, sparse and vector/matrix operations, and on-device learning.

Expected outcomes: a maintainable evaluation environment combining fast exploration with selected higherfidelity validation paths; cross-layer models and interface contracts, reusable data schemes, benchmarking flows, system-level Pareto analyses and design guidelines for emerging AI accelerators – a decision-support instrument for future research projects.


Candidate profile: PhD in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, with a strong background in several of: computer architecture and AI accelerators; performance, energy and area modelling; design space exploration and multi-objective optimization; hardwaresoftware co-design and workload mapping; emerging memories, compute-in-memory or photonic computing. Strong Python skills and sound software-engineering practice are essential; experience with SystemC, C/C++, RISCV simulation, QEMU, PyTorch/ONNX workload flows, architecture simulators (NeuroSim, CiMLoop/AccelForge, Timeloop or similar) will be appreciated. Familiarity with circuit-level modelling or EDA is an asset, but the focus is architectural and system-level research.

Environment: the position is hosted by the Electronics group at INL (UMR CNRS 5270), Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Écully, France – an interdisciplinary environment spanning devices, circuits, architectures, design automation, photonics and integrated systems, with national and European collaborations.

Starting date: Fall 2026

Money is broken. Most people's wealth sits in products they did not choose, with fees they cannot see, and a private banker costs more than they will ever pay. We are putting one in everyone's pocket: the same quality of advice for a €10K saver and a €10M client.

Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1M people now track their wealth with us, for free. Finary AI turns that financial context into a plan, and our own investment products and in-house wealth advisors (Finary One) make it real: clarity on what you have, guidance on where you are going, action to get there.

Why now?

AI makes this vision possible, and 3 things make it hard to copy:

  • Data: years of per-user financial history, goals and risk profiles that no public dataset holds.

  • Brand: half of our new users come from our own channels, and 1 signup in 5 names our YouTube channel.

  • Licences: stocks, ETFs and crypto on one regulated platform, passportable across Europe. We started early, when a simple registration was enough: PSAN in 2022, Investment Firm licence in March 2026, MiCA in July 2026. Since July, every crypto platform in Europe must be licensed or stop.

Many fintechs will have the AI, and a few will have the licences. We have all 3. We're 70 builders who genuinely love what they do: real ownership from day one, tier-1 salary and equity, offices in the heart of Paris with hybrid remote, and quarterly gatherings we actually look forward to.

We hire A-players who are as kind as they are demanding, people whose ideas transform not just our product but the way we work and think. It's the single most important skill of the next decade and a real bar here. Everyone at Finary has rebuilt how they work around it. The role

The CEO Office owns Finary's most important strategic projects, the delivery of the business plan, company’s operating rituals and runs the board and investor relations. Today one Chief of Staff carries all of it. You join as a real partner: you own a share of these projects from day one and move key topics forward fast, side by side with the Chief of Staff and the CEO.

Finary Media fait la première chaîne YouTube d’éducation financière en France : 880 000 abonnés et 5 à 10 millions de vues par mois, tout est produit en interne. Chaque vidéo est traitée comme un produit : on mesure, on itère, on améliore.

data.title: System Architect
data.description:
Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness.

As a System Architect, you will be responsible for our solid-state transformer as a complete system. You will connect the work of our power electronics, magnetics, and mechanical and thermal engineering teams into one coherent system, and ensure it meets the requirements of hyperscale data center customers.

Instead of specializing in a single subsystem, your mission is to keep the whole system in view: balancing efficiency, size, cost, reliability and manufacturability, guiding the key technical trade-offs, and taking our SST from prototype to a product ready for certification and series production.

This role is for you if…
you’ve owned a complex high-power system rather than one part of it. You enjoy keeping the whole picture in view, making the call on trade-offs between expert teams, and bringing just enough structure to a fast-moving team without slowing it down.

This role isn’t for you if…
you’ve spent your career going deep on a single component or subsystem, or you manage projects without making the technical decisions yourself. It’s also not a fit if you need a fixed specification and established processes before you can start.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the system architecture of the SST and its key performance metrics, including efficiency, power density, cost, thermal performance, reliability, manufacturability and control performance.

  • Coordinate the subsystems of the SST (AC/DC, DC/DC, magnetics, mechanical and thermal) and their interfaces, ensuring the work of each team is compatible and consistent with the system design.

  • Lead system-level trade-off decisions and set technical priorities across teams.

  • Define and maintain system requirements, interface specifications and change management, ensuring design changes are assessed for their impact across the system.

  • Translate the requirements of data center operators and hyperscalers into system specifications, and track how they evolve.

  • Explore and compare different system architectures and their integration in the datacenter power supply chain

  • Drive standardization and design for manufacturing across subsystems in preparation for series production.

data.title: Delivery Transformation Principal
(Senior) Deployment Strategist
data.description:
You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants.

Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Palantir, McKinsey, Meta, Google, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT?

You will take a signed logo and turn them into a flagship reference. That means getting onto the shopfloor fast, understanding what drives their KPIs, and deploying Ethon's agentic workflows where the impact is highest. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. This is what you'll do:

  • Own the deployment: You're the person who makes sure go-live happens on time and the customer's team knows how to use it. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations.

  • Turn shopfloor problems into business cases: An operator tells you yield drops on line 3 every Tuesday night. You figure out why, quantify what it costs, and build the case for the next deployment. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations.

  • Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed.

  • Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor.

  • Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better.

  • Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?

The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck.

  • You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case

  • You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor

  • You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors

  • You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools

  • You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it

  • You're open to travel 30-50% of the time

This is how we'll set you up in your first six months:

  • Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account.

  • Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team.

  • Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion.

Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like:

  • Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes

  • Top-tier consulting, ready to stop writing recommendations and start executing them

  • Digital transformation or operational excellence roles inside manufacturing companies, where things were moving too slowly for you

  • Manufacturing or process engineering, where you've lived the problems Ethon solves, you know what a plant manager actually cares about, and customers trust you the moment you walk onto their floor

  • A technical degree in chemical, mechanical, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field

Bonus:

  • Experience with MES, ERP, Historian, or quality systems in manufacturing environments

  • Fluency in German, French, or another European language

WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU?

We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here outgrow their title fast.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Performance-based career & growth paths

  • On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules

  • Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success

  • Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation

  • Flexible parental leave

  • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position Description

As an Engineering Manager at Sonar, you will lead a squad of 8 developers to build, automate and operate software used by millions of Sonar customers worldwide. You will own the professional growth and development of your team, enabling them to build well-crafted software for our products, and promoting a high-performance engineering culture. 

You will improve our products by leading the elaboration of the squad's annual and quarterly objectives in close collaboration with the AI team while contributing to and overseeing technical architecture and engineering direction. 

You will help to bring consistency across Sonar’s engineering organization by collaborating closely with your engineering manager peers to foster and share engineering best practices.


What you will do

  • Lead and manage a team of Engineers, providing guidance, support, and mentorship to help individuals grow in autonomy and contribute to the team's success.

  • Hold yourself and your team accountable to a high engineering standard.

  • Foster a safe culture of feedback, continuous improvement, and collaboration, encouraging team members to share their ideas and concerns openly.

  • Align feedback with other teams to ensure things operate smoothly between teams.

  • Partner with product managers, designers, and team leads to develop and communicate a clear vision for the squad that aligns with the company strategy and ensure that the team's work and focus align with this vision.

  • Ensure the squad defines clear objectives that are aligned with team, department, and company goals.

  • Be accountable for tracking sprint progress.

  • Be accountable that processes and ceremonies align with company expectations to deliver the best product successfully.

  • Ensure that the right level of collaboration happens with the squad stakeholders (Product Managers, developer squads, Marketing, Management, etc.).

  • Partner with the Hiring team to recruit talented Engineers for the team. Participate in improving the hiring process for the team and ensuring we recruit enough to reach our goals.

  • Be accountable that the onboarding of new team members is happening in the squad.

  • Lead by example, modeling the behaviors and values that the company holds dear, including humility and servant leadership.


    • Experience and qualifications

    The technical skills you will demonstrate

  • 8+ years of software development or equivalent experience in the software development domain, with a strong understanding of software testing. 

  • Having a developer mindset: experience with coding lifecycle, ability to produce secure code, to do code reviews, and to jump into an unknown codebase, language, and framework.

  • Advanced knowledge of the Java ecosystem

  • Good knowledge of at least one programming language along with its development environment to understand end-user's context and expectations.

  • Experience with Agile methodologies.

    •  

    The leadership skills you will demonstrate

  • 3+ years of experience in a leadership or management role, with a proven track record of delivering results and building high-performing teams.

  • A growth mindset and a passion for helping individuals and teams reach their full potential.

  • Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and resources effectively.

  • Capability to make concrete progress in the face of ambiguity and imperfect knowledge.

    •  

    The soft skills you will demonstrate

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to clearly identify the problem to be solved and articulate it, before jumping to possible solutions/actions.

  • Ability to deliver effective feedback.

  • Good listening skills.

  • Ability to face small conflicts in a healthy way and help parties resolve them.

  • High level of autonomy and still accepting help and feedback from team members and peers.

  • Ability to challenge yourself.

    • In-office culture

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

     

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

    If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

data.title: Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor
data.description:
We are currently looking for an experienced Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor to join an international financial services environment and contribute to strengthening its technology, cybersecurity and risk management landscape.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise with a strong understanding of governance, risk and controls. You will take ownership of complex audit engagements, challenge existing practices and provide independent insights that support informed decision-making at senior management level.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically experienced professional who enjoys investigating complex IT environments, identifying potential vulnerabilities and making a meaningful impact on the organisation’s security and resilience.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Plan, lead and deliver comprehensive IT audit engagements based on a risk-oriented approach, including the development of audit strategies and testing procedures.

  • Review and evaluate technology-related risk areas, including cybersecurity, IT governance, infrastructure, network security, access management, data protection, operational resilience and emerging technologies.

  • Apply your technical background to analyse complex IT architectures, identify potential weaknesses and assess the effectiveness of existing security measures and internal controls.

  • Review findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, security assessments and monitoring activities, translating technical observations into relevant risk insights.

  • Assess emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence and AI-driven solutions, and evaluate their implications for cybersecurity, governance and technology risk.

  • Present audit findings, recommendations and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management and executive-level decision-makers.

  • Prepare structured and impactful audit documentation, ensuring that identified issues are clearly communicated and actionable.

  • Track remediation activities and evaluate the effectiveness of implemented measures.

  • Work closely with colleagues across IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Governance and Business functions to promote continuous improvement and strengthen the overall control environment.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a comparable discipline, alternatively equivalent professional experience.

  • At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in IT, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Technology Risk or a related technical field.

  • Strong practical knowledge of several core technology and security domains, such as Network Security, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Operations or IT Resilience.

  • Experience working with technical security assessments, penetration testing results, vulnerability scanning solutions or comparable security tools.

  • Previous exposure to IT Audit, Internal Audit, External Audit, Technology Risk or another assurance-related function is highly desirable.

  • Professional certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or equivalent qualifications are considered an advantage.

  • Interest in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning and AI-driven technologies, particularly in relation to security, governance and risk management. Practical experience in AI governance or AI-based solutions is beneficial.

  • Strong analytical capabilities, a structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to assess complex technical information independently.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge established practices constructively and engage with senior decision-makers.

  • High professional integrity, sound judgement and a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Fluent English is required. German and/or French language skills are an additional advantage.

  • Willingness to undertake international business travel, approximately 20 days or more annually.

Benefits & Culture

  • Work in an international financial services environment where technology, security and risk management play a central role.

  • Take on a highly visible position with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and strategic decision-making.

  • Enjoy a broad and varied scope of responsibility across technology, cybersecurity and emerging risk areas.

  • Collaborate with experienced professionals from IT, Business, Risk and Governance in a supportive and knowledge-driven environment.

  • Benefit from opportunities for continuous professional development, specialist training and relevant industry certifications.

  • Contribute to meaningful initiatives that strengthen organisational security, resilience and governance.

  • Join a professional culture that values integrity, initiative, collaboration and individual expertise.

data.title: CFO (Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung)
data.description:
Das Universitäre Zentrum für Zahnmedizin Basel (UZB) vereint Patientenbehandlung, akademische Lehre und Forschung unter einem Dach. Mit rund 300 Mitarbeitenden, rund 100'000 Behandlungen pro Jahr und einem Umsatz von ca. CHF 40 Mio. erbringt das UZB seine Leistungen unter anderem auf Basis von Leistungsaufträgen mit der Universität Basel und dem Kanton Basel-Stadt. Wir suchen eine oder einen CFO mit überzeugenden betriebswirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Kenntnissen. Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung ist neben dem Finanzwissen auch unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln gefragt, um das Unternehmen gesamtheitlich zu steuern und weiterzuentwickeln.

Ihre Verantwortung

  • Sie verantworten die finanzielle Führung des UZB – von der Budget-, Liquiditäts- und Finanzplanung über das Rechnungswesen und die Rechnungslegung nach Swiss GAAP FER bis hin zum Controlling – und stellen ein aussagekräftiges, stufengerechtes Reporting an unsere Leitungserbringer, die Geschäftsleitung und den Verwaltungsrat sicher.

  • Sie sichern die Finanzierung und Liquidität, entwickeln das Risikomanagement und das interne Kontrollsystem weiter und sind Ansprechperson für den Prüfungsausschuss des Verwaltungsrats und die Revisionsstelle.

  • Sie führen und entwickeln die Bereiche Finanzen (rund 10 Mitarbeitende), IT (3), Technischer Dienst (3) und Einkauf mit vier direkt unterstellten Führungspersonen und fördern die Zusammenarbeit über Fachgrenzen hinweg.

  • Sie bringen die Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Abläufen und Systemen voran und entscheiden bei der laufenden Evaluation einer neuen ERP-Lösung massgeblich mit.

  • Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung tragen Sie auch die gesamtunternehmerische Verantwortung mit und bringen sich in Fragen der Unternehmensentwicklung aktiv ein.

  • Sie beraten die CEO und die Geschäftsleitung als Sparringpartner in allen betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragen und erarbeiten Business Cases für neue Angebote und Projekte.

  • Sie schaffen Entscheidungsgrundlagen für den Dialog mit internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen in einem öffentlich-rechtlich geprägten Umfeld und pflegen den Kontakt zu den relevanten Stakeholdern.

Ihr beruflicher Hintergrund

  • Sie verfügen über substanzielles Know-how in Finanzen und Controlling sowie über Erfahrung in einer verantwortlichen Finanzführungsfunktion.

  • Sie haben einen (Fach-) Hochschulstudium in Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen oder sind Expertin bzw. Experte in Rechnungslegung und Controlling; Erfahrung mit Swiss GAAP FER und SAP ist von Vorteil.

  • Sie haben Führungserfahrung, sind es gewohnt bei Entscheidungsprozessen mitzuwirken und anschliessend die Entscheidungen in ihrem Verantwortungsbereich konsequent umzusetzen. Sie kommunizieren differenziert und transparent, arbeiten pragmatisch und verbinden finanzielle Sorgfalt mit Offenheit für neue Lösungen.

  • Sie verfügen über stilsichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Sie interessieren sich für Digitalisierung und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Daten und neuen Technologien.

  • Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen oder in einer öffentlich-rechtlichen Organisation sind willkommen, doch keine Voraussetzung.

Was die Aufgabe auszeichnet

Das UZB ist eine dynamische Institution: 2016 gegründet und seit 2021 um rund 30 % gewachsen. Unsere Strukturen, Prozesse und Systeme lassen sich aktiv mitprägen. Sie verbinden eine finanzielle Schlüsselrolle mit der Möglichkeit, die Weiterentwicklung einer Unternehmung mit gesellschaftlichem Auftrag aus Geschäftsleitungsperspektive mitzugestalten. Die Position verlangt Nähe zum Tagesgeschäft ebenso wie einen verlässlichen Blick auf das Ganze.

Senior Manager Client Media (m/f/d) – Fixed-Term Contract

Technology Marketing Manager
data.description:
About the role

We are looking for a Technology Marketing Manager to turn Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and long-term vision into compelling stories for engineers and executives.

This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, marketing, and go-to-market.

You will develop a deep understanding of Neural Concept’s technology and work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to create and continuously improve how our platform is explained to enterprise audiences.

Your work will directly shape how global enterprises perceive Neural Concept: not as a point solution, but as an intelligence layer that brings AI into engineering workflows, helping Global 2000 engineering leaders design better products faster.

This is a high-impact role with significant autonomy, offering the opportunity to take ownership of complex topics, shape Neural Concept’s technical and market narrative, and potentially grow into leading a product marketing team as the company scales.

What you will do

Technology & Product Narrative

  • Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and roadmap.

  • Act as a primary internal reference for market-facing technology and product narratives.

  • Turn complex technical concepts into clear explanations, examples, and value stories for engineering and executive audiences.

  • Work closely with leadership and Product to ensure alignment between vision, roadmap, and market messaging.

Messaging & Positioning Framework

  • Structure and maintain the core messaging framework in collaboration with leadership and Sales Enablement.

  • Define how Neural Concept’s technology is positioned across personas, industries, and use cases.

  • Ensure consistency and clarity across all market-facing materials (website, flagship assets, campaigns).

  • Clearly articulate technical differentiation and competitive positioning in a factual, grounded way.

Content Strategy & Creation

  • Own and produce technology- and product-driven content across flagship assets (hero blogs, whitepapers, product pages, decks).

  • Translate ongoing technical innovation into concrete, high-quality content that can be used externally by customers, partners, and sales teams.

  • Partner with the Design team to shape and produce high-quality product and technology content, including diagrams, visual explanations, demos and videos.

Go-to-Market Foundations (in collaboration)

  • Produce use-case content, value stories, and messaging inputs that Sales Enablement and Marketing actively use in customer conversations and campaigns.

  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement to ensure product and technology narratives are translated into clear, consistent sales messaging.

  • Support entry into new industries or use cases by clarifying positioning and value stories, without owning sales strategy or execution.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product, Applied Engineering, Sales Enablement, Marketing, and Leadership.

  • Act as a bridge between technical teams and market-facing functions.

  • Contribute to strategic discussions on positioning, category evolution, and long-term narrative.

Who you are

Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in technology marketing, technical product marketing, or market-facing technical roles within B2B or deep-tech companies.

  • You combine technical depth with a strong sense for marketing and storytelling, whether you built it in a marketing role or on the technical side.

  • Demonstrated ability to deeply understand complex technology platforms and systems, and reason about how they create value in real-world engineering workflows.

  • Engineering background (e.g., mechanical, aerospace, or computational engineering) or hands-on familiarity with CAD, CAE, or simulation tools is a strong plus.

  • Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to translate technical capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs into clear market positioning.

  • Proven ability to structure and maintain coherent messaging and positioning frameworks grounded in technical reality.

  • Track record of producing substantial, high-quality marketing content for complex technical products.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt the message to very different audiences, from engineers and technical experts to executives, decision-makers, and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfortable engaging in technical discussions and asking the right questions to build accurate, credible market narratives.

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken.

Ways of working

  • Able to drive complex topics from exploration to execution.

  • Able to operate with a high degree of autonomy while staying closely aligned with leadership and peers.

  • Execution-oriented, pragmatic, and hands-on.

  • Open, direct, and collaborative in working across functions.

  • Energized by a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. You adapt quickly, stay ahead of change, and are willing to challenge your own choices and iterate on them.

  • Genuine passion for technology, engineering, innovation, and AI. You naturally follow what’s happening in the field, enjoy exploring how new technologies change the way products are designed, and have a strong appetite for learning and continuous improvement.

  • Proactive and eager to step in beyond the core scope when projects call for it, contributing to product-related communications such as events, press releases, website updates, or newsletters.

What you get

  • Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.

  • Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

  • Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

  • Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

data.title: IT Applications & AI Specialist
data.description:
Da oltre 25 anni offriamo sui mercati globali cosmetici Made in Italy. Progettiamo, sviluppiamo, produciamo e confezioniamo in-house. La produzione è effettuata dalla nostra azienda italiana di Siziano (Pavia-Milano Sud). Sostenibilità, qualità, innovazione e sicurezza sono per noi valori chiave.

Per la sede di Lugano siamo alla ricerca di un/a IT Applications & AI Specialist che contribuisca allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione dell’ecosistema digitale aziendale, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni Microsoft 365, alle applicazioni interne, all’automazione dei processi e ai progetti di Intelligenza Artificiale. La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con le diverse funzioni aziendali, raccogliendone le esigenze e traducendole in soluzioni tecnologiche concrete. Avrà un ruolo sia operativo sia progettuale nello sviluppo, nell’integrazione e nel mantenimento delle applicazioni aziendali, contribuendo alla digitalizzazione dei processi e alla realizzazione di progetti innovativi per il business.

Principali responsabilità:

  • sviluppare, gestire e ottimizzare soluzioni e flussi basati sull’ecosistema Microsoft 365, con particolare riferimento a SharePoint, Power Automate, Power Apps, Teams e agli strumenti di collaborazione e automazione aziendale
  • supportare le diverse funzioni aziendali nell’analisi delle esigenze e dei processi, individuando e sviluppando soluzioni digitali, automazioni e applicazioni basate sull’Intelligenza Artificiale in grado di migliorare l’efficienza operativa, l’integrazione dei dati e l’esperienza degli utenti
  • partecipare allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione delle applicazioni gestionali aziendali, contribuendo all’integrazione di funzionalità AI, API, flussi di dati e soluzioni di automazione a supporto delle diverse aree di business
  • seguire, dal punto di vista tecnico e applicativo, lo sviluppo del progetto digitale dedicato al settore cosmetico, collaborando alla definizione delle funzionalità, alla realizzazione delle soluzioni, ai test e alla relativa integrazione nell’ecosistema aziendale
  • garantire il corretto funzionamento delle soluzioni sviluppate, gestendo attività di manutenzione, aggiornamento, test, troubleshooting, documentazione tecnica e supporto agli utenti, anche in collaborazione con partner e fornitori esterni


Requisiti richiesti:

  • conoscenza dell’ecosistema Microsoft 365 e capacità di sviluppare o configurare soluzioni basate su SharePoint, Power Automate e Power Apps
  • competenze di programmazione, preferibilmente in Python, e familiarità con API, database, integrazioni tra sistemi e tecnologie di sviluppo moderne
  • conoscenza dei principi e degli strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale, automazione e analisi dei dati, con interesse per la loro applicazione concreta nei processi aziendali
  • capacità di analizzare le esigenze del business e tradurle in requisiti funzionali e soluzioni tecniche sostenibili, scalabili e semplici da utilizzare
  • buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, autonomia operativa, capacità di problem solving e attitudine alla collaborazione con interlocutori tecnici e non tecnici


Requisiti formativi e professionali preferenziali:

  • laurea o diploma a indirizzo informatico, ingegneristico, scientifico o formazione equivalente
  • esperienza nello sviluppo, nella migrazione o nell’integrazione di applicazioni e flussi all’interno dell’ecosistema Microsoft 365
  • esperienza nella gestione del ciclo di vita di un’applicazione, dall’analisi dei requisiti allo sviluppo, test, rilascio, manutenzione e supporto agli utenti
  • familiarità con Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, Git, SQL, servizi cloud, API REST e strumenti di versionamento del codice
  • esperienza, anche maturata attraverso progetti personali, formativi o professionali, nello sviluppo di soluzioni AI, chatbot, assistenti digitali, sistemi di automazione o applicazioni basate su modelli linguistici
  • approccio pragmatico e orientato alla soluzione, curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie e capacità di operare contemporaneamente su attività di sviluppo, integrazione e supporto applicativo
  • capacità di lavorare in team e di collaborare in modo trasversale con le diverse funzioni aziendali, comprendendone obiettivi, priorità e processi


Cerchiamo una persona curiosa, concreta e orientata all’innovazione, capace di coniugare competenze tecniche e comprensione delle esigenze del business.

Il profilo ideale possiede un approccio hands-on, autonomia operativa e interesse verso la sperimentazione di nuove tecnologie. È in grado di seguire un progetto dalla raccolta delle esigenze fino al rilascio della soluzione, mantenendo attenzione alla qualità, alla sicurezza, alla semplicità di utilizzo e alla sostenibilità nel tempo.

In GFL accogliamo con piacere ogni candidatura e crediamo nel valore delle persone, nella loro unicità e nelle loro storie. Valorizziamo la diversità e offriamo pari opportunità a chiunque voglia far parte del nostro percorso.

data.title: Expansion Associate (H/F) - 100%
data.description:
Tu n'abandonnes pas au premier refus, ni au dixième. Tu traites une liste le vendredi après-midi avec le même soin que le lundi matin, et tu mènes à terme ce que tu as commencé, pour que rien ne reste en suspens et que rien ne vieillisse en silence dans un coin. Tu n'as besoin de personne derrière ton épaule pour tenir ton niveau d'exigence. Et quand un cas ne rentre pas dans le processus, tu le signales au lieu de bricoler une solution.

Si tu te reconnais dans ces lignes, tu es au bon endroit.

En tant qu'Expansion Associate, tu es le chasseur ou la chasseuse d'appartements de Room Estate en Suisse romande, avec un accent sur Genève. Tu es responsable de l'acquisition d'appartements de A à Z : tu passes le marché au crible, tu évalues chaque appartement sous l'angle du coliving, tu le visites sur place, tu postules en notre nom, tu relances et tu accompagnes le dossier jusqu'à la signature du bail. C'est un rôle pour les personnes qui passent à l'action, et c'est précisément sa force : fréquence, ténacité et sens des responsabilités dans un processus clairement défini. Notre principe directeur : la croissance naît d'un tri des annonces à haute fréquence, d'une évaluation rigoureuse et de relances systématiques, pas de coups de chance. Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec notre responsable de l'équipe Acquisition, qui tranche les cas d'appréciation, et ton travail se mesure à ce qui compte au final : les chambres acquises, les baux signés et la qualité de ce que tu ramènes.

Tasks

  • Tu passes les portails immobiliers au crible de manière systématique, chaque jour et avec un regard sûr pour ce qui convient.

  • Tu évalues chaque appartement sous l'angle du coliving : plan, état, immeuble, et la question de savoir si la propriété est prête à jouer le jeu.

  • Tu organises les visites et tu te rends sur place pour vérifier sur l'objet réel ce que promet l'annonce.

  • Tu postules en notre nom et tu positionnes Room Estate comme le locataire que toute régie souhaite avoir.

  • Tu relances jusqu'à ce qu'une décision soit prise. Aucun dossier ne s'enlise.

  • Tu accompagnes le dossier jusqu'à la signature et tu contrôles le bail à l'aide de notre liste de contrôle : points critiques, clauses manquantes et écarts par rapport à l'annonce.

  • Tu tiens le suivi des dossiers à jour : chaque objet saisi, chaque statut traçable.

Requirements

  • Sens des responsabilités et autonomie. Tu fais avancer un processus de bout en bout à une fréquence élevée et à un rythme fiable, tu vas au bout de chaque suivi et tu ne laisses aucun dossier s'enliser. C'est le cœur de ce rôle.

  • Maîtrise du français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, dans les échanges avec les régies et les propriétaires.

  • Ténacité et sens de la négociation, le marché locatif genevois dit souvent non, et cela ne te déstabilise pas.

  • Un œil pour les plans, tu vois d'emblée si le coliving fonctionne dans un appartement et combien de chambres sont réalistes.

  • Rigueur dans le travail avec des listes de contrôle, tu vas au bout de chaque point plutôt que de faire les choses à peu près, et tu repères les écarts. Aucune connaissance spécialisée en droit du bail n'est requise.

  • Permis de conduire catégorie B et disponibilité pour des visites régulières à Genève, dans la région lémanique et dans le reste de la Suisse romande.

  • Anglais courant, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, notre langue de travail interne.

BONUS

  • Expérience dans le secteur immobilier suisse (formation en gérance immobilière, cours USPI, activité de courtage)

  • Réseau existant auprès des régies et des propriétaires à Genève et dans la région lémanique

  • Expérience dans l'univers du coliving ou des appartements meublés avec services

  • Connaissances de base du droit du bail suisse

  • Allemand

Benefits

  • Salaire fixe plus bonus progressif pour chaque chambre acquise, sans plafond : plus tu acquiers de chambres, plus tu gagnes par chambre.

  • Bureau à Lausanne, avec la possibilité de télétravailler certains jours

  • Équipement de ton choix (ordinateur portable, écran, accessoires)

  • Des processus et des listes de contrôle documentés, et un·e responsable d'équipe à qui reviennent les exceptions, pour que tu puisses faire ta part avec précision au lieu d'improviser

  • Un rôle qui t'appartient : tu ne fais pas partie d'une équipe d'acquisition, tu es l'acquisition en Suisse romande

  • Une équipe internationale et solidaire, avec une vraie culture de l'apprentissage

  • Budget de formation continue (cours, livres, conférences)

  • Une vraie évolution : ton ambition détermine jusqu'où tu iras, tes résultats à quelle vitesse. Ton périmètre de responsabilité grandit avec les deux.

Chez Room Estate, tu bénéficies de vraies responsabilités et d'un feedback direct, sans micromanagement ni langue de bois. On se tutoie, on se dit les choses, et nous sommes exigeants : tu as le droit de l'être tout autant avec nous.

Des séminaires d'équipe, une fête d'été annuelle et une collaboration étroite avec des collègues de différents pays font partie de l'aventure et élargissent ton réseau personnel et professionnel. Mais l'essentiel est simple : nous voulons progresser chaque jour et nous cherchons des personnes qui le veulent aussi. Ici, tu assumes un rôle qui compte, dans un environnement international, et tu contribues activement à façonner l'avenir du coliving en Europe.

Rejoins Room Estate et construis avec nous l'avenir du logement. 🚀
