Je werkt aan vraagstukken met betrekking tot netwerkarchitecturen, (simulatie)protocollen zoals DIS en HLA, netwerkbeveiliging en schaalbaarheid van complexe simulatieomgevingen. Je levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan het mogelijk maken van interoperabiliteit tussen simulatoren, operationele systemen en autonome platforms, en bent betrokken bij de (door)ontwikkeling van zowel bestaande als nieuwe simulatienetwerken. In multidisciplinaire teams werk je samen met onder andere softwareontwikkelaars, domeinexperts en toekomstige eindgebruikers aan innovatieve oplossingen voor nationale en internationale stakeholders. Je bent hiervoor bereid om te reizen naar verschillende locaties, voornamelijk binnen Nederland.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent iemand die in kansen denkt en nieuwsgierig is om bij te dragen aan oplossingen die werken in de praktijk. Je hebt heel makkelijk contact met eindgebruikers en kan hun wensen en ideeën snel in creatieve implementaties omzetten. Met je creatieve instelling maak je nieuwe technieken snel eigen en weet je deze te vertalen naar concrete resultaten!

Daarnaast:

  • Heb je een afgeronde bachelor of master opleiding in ICT, Computer Science, Informatica, Informatiekunde, of vergelijkbaar;

  • Heb je minstens 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minstens 5 jaar ervaring op het gebied van netwerktechnologie, TCP/UDP, netwerkprotocollen, routering, switching en netwerkbeveiliging;

  • Beheers je meerdere programmeertalen zoals C, C++, C#, Java en ervaring in scripting om experimenteeromgevingen snel op te zetten of aan te passen;

  • Heb je interesse in experimenteren, wargaming en simulatie in een R&D-context;

  • Heb je ervaring met het ontwerpen en beheren van robuuste, schaalbare netwerkomgevingen;

  • Ben je bereid om je te verdiepen in (militaire) luchtvaartoperaties;

  • Werk je graag samen, durft je te experimenteren en kan je technische keuzes uitleggen aan niet-technische collega’s;

  • Kan jij je in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal zowel mondeling als schriftelijk uitstekend uitdrukken.

Nice to have:

  • Ervaring met of interesse in simulatie- en interoperabiliteitsprotocollen (DIS/HLA/FOMs);

  • Ervaring met het opzetten van tijdelijke of experimentele infrastructuren;

  • Kennis van netwerkbeveiliging of VPN-oplossingen;

  • Ervaring met monitoring- of observabilitytools;

  • Interesse in nieuwe technologieën zoals autonome systemen, AI in simulatie of digitale twins.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten.

Naast dit alles bieden wij jou:

  • De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken;

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4330,- en € 7000,- (bij fulltime dienstverband), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • 45 verlofdagen (bij fulltime dienstverband);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer;

  • Een zorgtoelage via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Bij de afdeling Training & Simulatie werken op dit moment rond de 100 deskundigen op het gebied van simulatie, informatica, training, luchtvaart en psychologie. Binnen onze projecten wordt multidisciplinair samengewerkt, zowel binnen als buiten het NLR. De afdeling beschikt over allerlei onderzoeksfaciliteiten zoals een battlelab en simulatoren voor gevechtsvliegtuig- en onbemande systemen en een laboratorium dat zich richt op AR/VR innovaties. Een plezierige werkomgeving vinden we essentieel. De sfeer binnen de afdeling is informeel en collegiaal en we vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zich thuis kan voelen bij ons.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties.

Bij ons werken bijna 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt.

Wil jij meer weten?

Bel of mail dan met Pien Moller (recruiter) via 0611443915 of Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

data.title: Software Lead Engineer | NTS Eindhoven
data.description:
At NTS, we make it possible together. Technology inspires and drives us; it is our passion. Every day we work on unique solutions to complex challenges. Whether it's ultra-complex or ultra-precise solutions, we are proud of what we do and what we deliver.

Want to set the technical direction of complex software projects and guide engineering teams towards reliable, high-quality solutions? Are you passionate about software development and high-tech product development, and do you enjoy combining technical expertise with technical leadership? Then get started as Software Lead Engineer at NTS Eindhoven and let's make it possible together.

Job Description

As Software Lead Engineer/ Technical Lead at NTS Eindhoven, you set the technical direction for our software projects and coordinate the technical work of the engineers assigned to them. Working in collaborative teams of fewer than ten colleagues, you translate project objectives and complex requirements into software architecture, design decisions and executable technical plans.

This is a technical leadership role without line-management responsibility. You lead through technical direction, coordination and coaching, while the Group Lead or Competence Manager remains responsible for people management.

Our teams develop qualification tools, semiconductor equipment, defence and healthcare systems, and other advanced technology solutions. You collaborate closely with software, mechanical, electrical and mechatronics engineers to deliver integrated system solutions that meet high quality standards.

We value clear and transparent communication. You proactively identify technical risks and roadblocks, support the team in resolving challenges and ensure that solutions are delivered in line with project objectives.

Furthermore, your key responsibilities are:

  • Lead the technical side of software projects, including architecture, design and technical decision-making;

  • Coordinate the technical work of engineers allocated to your projects and ensure alignment with project plans;

  • Provide accurate technical estimates and planning input to project managers;

  • Safeguard software quality by promoting best practices, code reviews and effective test strategies;

  • Identify technical risks and roadblocks early and define and implement mitigation actions;

  • Coach and support colleagues technically, encourage knowledge sharing and contribute to continuous improvement;

  • Stay close to the code and contribute hands-on whenever required.

Job Requirements

To be successful in this role, you bring a strong combination of technical expertise, leadership capabilities and interpersonal skills. You recognise yourself in the following profile:

  • Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field;

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in developing technical software using C#, .NET/.NET Framework or C++ (knowledge of C is a plus);

  • Proven experience in setting technical direction, coordinating engineering activities and guiding other software engineers, with or without formal line-management responsibility;

  • Experience in UI development, for example WPF, and a strong understanding of OOP principles and UML design;

  • Experience working in an Agile development environment and with Azure DevOps or similar platforms;

  • Experience in a high-tech mechatronic environment is a strong advantage;

  • Knowledge of one or more of the following areas is a plus: databases, DevOps, test strategy, electronics or mechatronics, and computer vision;

  • Excellent communication and social skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics in an understandable way;

  • Proficient in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Dutch is a plus;

  • A proactive team player with a strong willingness to learn, develop and collaborate in the fast-evolving high-tech industry.

Your terms of employment

At NTS, we combine our passion for technology with innovative solutions to complex challenges. You get the freedom and confidence to fully use and develop your talents in a dynamic and energetic environment. We invest both in technology and in you as a future colleague!

With this challenge, we offer the following terms of employment:

  • Competitive salary;

  • A position at NTS Eindhoven, with a working week of at least 32 hours;

  • Personal growth and development opportunities, for example through training and/or education;

  • 27 vacation days and an additional 13 ADV days;

  • Excellent pension plan with PME;

  • Travel expense allowance paid monthly, with a maximum of 50 km per single journey and an allowance of €0.21 per km;

About NTS

We deliver unique solutions to complex challenges and drive technological advancement for our customers. By combining development, manufacturing and assembly, we play an integral role in bringing the supply chain together. We combine the best skills and brightest ideas into a working system for the world's most advanced Semiconductor, Opto-Mechatronics and Analytical solutions. For this reason, we have grown into a Tier-1 supplier to OEMs and an international player operating from various (production) sites in Europe, Asia and the US.

Although we offer our teams around the world a great place to work, we do not forget to remain firmly rooted locally. Ultimately, the core of NTS is our people. Their excellent manufacturing skills, customer-focused mindset and clear technical solutions have made NTS what it is today. Together, we create a culture that everyone can be proud of because we make it possible together. That's why we take every opportunity to celebrate our people, our craftsmanship and our successes.

Ben jij analytisch sterk en lijkt het je interessant om met AI écht impact te maken bij verschillende organisaties? Wil je werken aan projecten waarin strategie, technologie en AI samenkomen? Dan is een carrière als junior AI consultant bij IG&H iets voor jou.

Bij IG&H start je als Junior AI Consultant binnen ons Data & AI-team, onderdeel van onze consultancypraktijk. Dat betekent dat je niet alleen met technologie werkt, maar ook met klanten — van boardroom tot operations. Je leert hoe je AI-oplossingen vertaalt naar concrete toepassingen die organisaties slimmer, efficiënter en innovatiever maken.

Over de werkzaamheden:

  • Je helpt klanten in retail, financiële dienstverlening en gezondheidszorg om hun data door middel van AI succesvol in te zetten;

  • Je combineert machine learning, datamodellering en AI met strategisch inzicht;

  • Je vertaalt businessvraagstukken naar praktische AI-oplossingen;

  • Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams samen met collega-consultants, data scientists en engineers;

  • Je presenteert je inzichten en aanbevelingen op een heldere en overtuigende manier aan klanten;

  • Je ondersteunt organisaties bij AI-adoptie en het realiseren van duurzame verandering;

  • Je leert continu bij via training, coaching en uitdagende projecten.

Kortom: je bouwt niet alleen kennis op van AI en data, maar ontwikkelt ook de adviesvaardigheden die je carrière in de consultancy versnellen.

Over het team

Wij helpen onze klanten innoveren en gebruikmaken van de nieuwste data- en AI-technologie. Ons Data & AI-team bestaat uit ruim 40 data-experts, waaronder Data Scientists, Data Engineers en AI-consultants. Samen realiseren zij innovatieve data-, analytics- en AI-oplossingen voor klanten in Retail, Financial Services en Health. Het team groeit snel en heeft de ambitie om verder uit te bouwen tot een van de meest toonaangevende Data & AI-praktijken van Nederland. Die groei komt voort uit ons succes: klanten kiezen steeds vaker voor IG&H vanwege onze combinatie van strategisch inzicht, technische expertise en pragmatische executie. We werken aan projecten die direct bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming, efficiëntere processen en nieuwe businessmodellen. Voor professionals die impact willen maken is dit een omgeving waar ondernemerschap, innovatie en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. Hier bouw je niet alleen mee aan de toekomst van onze klanten, maar ook aan de verdere groei van het Data & AI-team zelf.

Wat jij meebrengt:

  • Een masterdiploma (WO-niveau) in Artificial Intelligence, Econometrie of Data Science of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Ervaring via een stage of werkstudentschap;

  • Vaardigheid in Python en/of R;

  • Sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden (Nederlands & Engels);

  • Interesse in consultancy, technologie en AI;

  • Nieuwsgierigheid, leergierigheid en een proactieve houding.

Wat wij jou bieden

  • Coaching on the job door ervaren consultants;

  • Je start vanaf januari 2026;

  • Een uitgebreid ontwikkelprogramma via de IG&H Academy;

  • Een uitstekend salaris, bonusregeling en mobiliteitsregeling of bedrijfsauto;

  • Healthy Human-programma voor jouw welzijn en balans;

  • We zijn een Great Place To Work (NPS > 60), en investeren in jouw ontwikkeling vanaf dag één;

  • Flexibiliteit: werken kan ook 32 uur per week (minimaal 4 dagen);

  • Veel plezier met een jong, ambitieus en sociaal team.

Waarom IG&H? 

IG&H transformeert toonaangevende bedrijven in de gezondheidszorg, retail en financiële sectoren. Samen met onze wereldklasse technologiepartners helpen we onze klanten vooruit te komen en relevant te blijven, met inzichtelijk advies, geweldig ontwerp en ongeëvenaarde digitale platforms. Onze uitzonderlijke resultaten komen voort uit het succesvol afstemmen van mensen, bedrijfsvoering en technologie. Met meer dan 650 getalenteerde collega’s aan boord, mensen die veranderingen en uitdagingen echt omarmen, hebben we een unieke cultuur gecreëerd die zowel hoog durft als hoog zorgt. We trekken buitengewone mensen aan en inspireren hen om de grenzen te verleggen voor zichzelf en onze klanten. 

Interesse?

Klaar om je carrière als AI consultant bij ons te starten? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met ons recruitmentteam via . Je kunt ook direct solliciteren via de sollicitatieknop. We hopen je snel te ontmoeten!

We willen dat onze medewerkers een afspiegeling zijn van de diversiteit in de samenleving. We werken samen met een opmerkelijke mix van talenten, persoonlijkheden en culturen. IG&H is trots een werkgever te zijn die gelijke kansen biedt. We geven om individualiteit, maar het belangrijkste is dat we trots zijn op onze collectieve prestaties en een Great Place to Work.

data.title: Senior Electronics Engineer — PCB Design & Bring-Up
data.description:
Opening

WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP

Details

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week)

Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands

About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Our core expertise lies in 3D vision and graphics technologies which we deploy in a dual-use context for inspection and defence. This role will focus mainly on the defence context where we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Our solutions are aimed to operate with low-cost and widely available sensors and compute. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.

Your role

You will collaborate closely with our embedded software, systems, and our hardware and forward deployed engineers to design and bring up the PCBs that power the compute and sensor platforms onboard our UAVs — from schematic to flight-ready hardware. You'll set the technical direction for PCB design and hardware bring-up, working with freelance designers and contract manufacturers along the way.

  • Designing multi-layer, high-density PCBs from schematic capture through layout and release.

  • Routing high-speed digital buses (PCIe Gen3/Gen4, MIPI CSI/DSI, USB 3.x) with proper impedance control and length matching.

  • Designing DC power systems for onboard UAV compute and sensor platforms that hold up under LiPo battery voltage sag and EMI from motors and ESCs.

  • Bringing up new boards: debugging schematics and circuits, chasing down electrical issues on the bench, and flashing firmware to validate hardware.

  • Setting technical direction for PCB design and bring-up across the hardware team.

  • Owning hardware from prototype through to a field-ready product.

What we expect from you

  • Senior-level PCB design experience — we'll judge this by the strength and depth of your portfolio rather than a fixed year count.

  • Deep experience with multi-layer PCB design and stack-up planning.

  • Proven high-speed digital routing experience: PCIe (Gen3/Gen4), MIPI CSI/DSI, USB 3.x — impedance-controlled, length-matched traces on multi-layer boards.

  • Experience with DC power filtering and EMI mitigation for battery-powered systems with noisy motor/ESC loads.

  • Hands-on PCB bring-up experience: schematic and circuit debugging, bench-level fault-finding, and flashing firmware to validate hardware.

  • Proficiency in Altium and/or KiCad, plus a circuit simulation tool.

  • A portfolio of PCB projects you've designed and brought up yourself — we will ask to see it.

  • Experience designing PCBs for RF/communications or radar applications, ideally with CST Studio Suite or similar EM simulation tools — a big plus, not required.

  • Experience with SBC/embedded carrier boards (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson, Rockchip) and camera/sensor interfacing (MIPI CSI cabling, I²C buses) is a plus.

  • A willingness to pick up and learn new concepts quickly and to self-acquire missing background knowledge.

  • A high degree of autonomy, determination and grit in making cool tech work.

  • Full time availability (40 hours)

What we offer

  • Money of course.

  • 25 vacation days per year.

  • Reimbursed travel expenses and company laptop.

  • (Really) flexible working hours — this role is bench- and lab-based, so we do need you on-site, but start/end times are yours to shape.

  • Working in an international, world-class team of engineers and entrepreneurs solving real-life problems with amazing technology.

  • Large freedom in how you work and implement solutions, project ownership is incredibly important to us.

  • The opportunity to take technical risks, to implement stuff the 'right' way and to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops. We are innovating, learning is to be expected.

  • Responsibility over the things you build, you are the expert on what you design and bring up.

The application procedure

  • If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us a portfolio of PCB projects you've designed and brought up, along with a resume, website, or other source that gives us a clear impression of your background and skills.

  • We'll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we'll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a second focused interview could follow.

  • If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we'll discuss the specifics.

  • Welcome to the team!

data.title: Head of Product
data.description:
Head of Product

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Location: Delft, the Netherlands (hybrid
Report to: CEO

About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.

Your role

As Head of Product, you own our product hands-on. You are the bridge between what the market and our operators need and what we build, turning field feedback and market insight into a clear roadmap and products people actually want to use. You own how our capabilities become real products: how they are shaped, packaged, priced, taken to market, and adopted by the people who use them in the field.

This is a hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves role, not a purely strategic one. You set the product’s direction together with the founders, and you do the work to make it happen: talking to users, writing requirements, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to ship. You bring structure to how we do product without turning it into bureaucracy.

You will work closely with the founders, engineering, and commercial. The company strategy is set with the founders; your job is to own the product within it and make it succeed.

Your responsibilities will include

• Product strategy & roadmap. Owning the product roadmap and prioritization, and keeping the product direction aligned with the company strategy as the market and the technology evolve.

• Market-to-technical bridge. Translating operator needs, market signals, and partner requirements into clear, well-scoped work for engineering, and translating technical capability back into value the market understands.

• Hands-on product delivery. Writing requirements, shaping features, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to get things shipped and validated.

• Product portfolio. Helping shape how our capabilities in detection, navigation, interception, and beyond fit together as a modular, scalable line-up rather than isolated tools.

• User experience & adoption. Owning how usable our products are for end users: ease of use, onboarding, training, documentation, and the adoption path from first deployment to routine operational use.

• Pricing & business model. Contributing to pricing, packaging, and business models across the product line-up, and owning the product side of the classic marketing mix (the 4Ps).

• Go-to-market. Partnering with commercial and business development on go-to-market for each capability, from positioning and narrative to capability briefs and demos.

• Market intelligence. Keeping an eye on the market: trends, competitors, adjacent opportunities, and where the next product bets should be.

• Regulatory & compliance awareness. Given the defence context, factoring export control, procurement, and relevant standards into product decisions, working with the right internal and external stakeholders.

• Lightweight product practices. Bringing just enough structure, process, and documentation to make product work repeatable, suited to a fast-moving deep-tech company.

What you will deliver in your first year

• A clear, documented product roadmap, aligned with the founders and understood across the company.

• A working feedback loop that turns field and operational insight into product decisions.

• Well-scoped, prioritized work flowing to engineering, with product shipped and validated with users.

• Input into pricing and business-model choices for the core product lines.

• A joint go-to-market plan with commercial for at least one capability, taken through to execution.

• Measurable improvement in product adoption and usability through better onboarding, documentation, and training for operators and partners.

• A working market map that informs the next set of product bets.

What we expect from you

• 5+ years in product management, with a track record of owning a product’s roadmap and shipping it in a technical product environment.

• Experience in a startup or scale-up environment: comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and wearing several hats.

• A strong bridge-builder: you connect customers and market reality to engineering, and you are comfortable in deeply technical conversations without being the engineer yourself.

• A genuinely hands-on mindset: you want to talk to users, write requirements, and work day-to-day with engineering, not only set direction from a distance.

• Exposure to pricing, packaging, and business-model decisions (the product side of the 4Ps).

• Experience working with commercial teams on go-to-market.

• A user-obsessed attitude: you care about adoption, usability, training, and documentation, not only features.

• The ability to read a market, spot trends, and turn them into concrete product opportunities.

• Strong communication and stakeholder skills, from the field and the shop floor to founders, partners, and government stakeholders.

Nice to have

• Domain experience in defence, drones/UAV, aerospace, or other dual-use or high-stakes technology. A real plus, but not a must.

• Experience navigating regulated environments and their impact on product, such as export control, procurement, certification, or standards.

• Experience as an early or first dedicated product hire, setting up lightweight product practices from scratch.

We know this exact combination is rare. If you have a strong track record of building products that reached real users, and the hands-on drive and judgment to navigate the rest, we want to talk.

What we offer

• The chance to own the product of a deep-tech defence company from an early stage, working directly with the founders.

• Equity participation. We want the people building the company to share in it.

• Competitive compensation.

• 25 vacation days per year.

• Reimbursed travel expenses and company laptop.

data.title: Internship - Programming & Automation
data.description:
WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP

Details

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: Full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months

Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands

About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced onboard UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers who are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members come from different backgrounds such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics, and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub on the TU Delft campus in the Faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low-TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.

The project

Sensor calibration is a manual job today, and it does not scale to the number of sensor units we intend to ship. We are building automated test and calibration infrastructure to fix that, starting with a cell built around a UFactory UF850 robotic arm on a linear rail.

We already have the arm and the calibration software. What we do not have is the physical cell around it, or the software that drives it. This first project is split into two internships that run side by side:

• Robot programming and automation — this position

• Mechanical design and integration — separate posting

The two interns will work closely together. Neither half of this project is any good on its own. This calibration cell is the first thing we are building on this front, not the last, so there is a good chance the right person carries on to other robotics and automation projects once it is running.

Your role

If you are the kind of person who is not satisfied until an automated system actually works reliably, not just once, this internship is designed for you.

We are looking for a Robot Programming & Automation Intern to help build the software behind our robotic test and automation infrastructure. Your first project is turning a robotic arm on a linear rail into a system that reliably captures good calibration data — but the skills involved are the same ones we’ll lean on for whatever we automate next: getting a robot to move well, knowing whether the data it’s collecting is any good, and building something solid enough to run unattended.

Getting that right is the substance of this internship, on this project and on whatever comes after it.

What you’ll do

• Build the robot control layer: drive the arm through its SDK, coordinate the linear rail, and plan safe motion inside a cell that also has a target, cables, and an operator in it.

• Design pose generation that’s actually informed by the calibration problem, including getting proper coverage across a multi-camera rig rather than just one lens at a time.

• Get the timing and synchronisation right between the robot, the cameras, and the captured data — this is where automated rigs usually go wrong.

• Gate data quality at capture time, and retry within the run rather than finding out later that a dataset is unusable.

• Close the loop with our existing calibration pipeline: feed it data, read back its results, and use that to decide what to capture next and when a run is done.

• Package captures with the metadata needed to make a calibration reproducible, and make the whole thing robust to failures mid-run.

• Build a simple operator-facing workflow: mount the rig, pick a profile, press go.

• Work closely with the mechanical intern — your requirements shape their fixture design, and their measurements shape your motion limits.

Who you are

• You are enrolled in a relevant study program (Robotics, Computer Science, Computational Science and Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace, Electrical Engineering, or similar).

• You are strong in Python. C++ is a plus.

• You are comfortable with 3D geometry: rigid transforms, rotation representations, coordinate frames, and keeping your conventions straight when it is 6pm and nothing lines up.

• You are interested in robot programming specifically — motion, reachability, collisions, repeatability — and not only in the vision maths around it.

• You understand enough about how camera calibration works to reason about what makes a dataset good or useless. You do not need to be able to write the solver.

• You have worked with real sensors and real robots, and you have learned that they lie about timing.

• You care about reliability. An automated process that works four times out of five is not automated.

• You write code that another engineer can pick up and extend.

• You are comfortable taking responsibility for software that moves physical hardware.

• You are independent, curious, organized, and resourceful.

• Linux does not scare you, and neither does a robot that moves the moment your code says move.

We care much more about what you have built and made work than about grades.

Nice to have

These are strong pluses, but not strict requirements:

• ROS 2, MoveIt 2, tf2, and motion planning in practice

• Experience with industrial or collaborative arm SDKs (UFactory / xArm, UR, Franka), or motion control more generally

• Hands-on camera calibration experience: OpenCV, Kalibr, ChArUco or AprilTag targets, hand-eye calibration

• Multi-camera rigs, and the specific pain of calibrating cameras with little or no overlapping field of view

• Machine vision cameras: triggering and synchronisation, GenICam, exposure control, rolling versus global shutter

• Coverage or observability reasoning: understanding why some poses inform a parameter and others do not

• Simulation environments (Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo)

• Docker, CI, and the habit of writing tests before you need them

• Experience turning a research script into something an operator can actually use

Please include

When applying, please include links, repositories, or writeups that show us you build things that work. For example:

• GitHub repositories, with a note on which parts you actually wrote

• robot arm or robot motion projects

• camera calibration, multi-view geometry, SLAM, or structure-from-motion work

• data capture pipelines, test automation, or anything that had to run unattended

• computer vision projects

• simulation work

• a short writeup of something that broke and how you found the cause

• anything that demonstrates hands-on technical ownership

If you have ever chased a calibration error you couldn’t explain, eventually traced it to a timestamp, and fixed it properly, you’ll probably fit right in.

Requirements

• Enrolled in a relevant study program (Robotics, Computer Science, CSE, Mechatronics, Aerospace, Electrical Engineering, or similar)

• Strong programming skills, Python at minimum

• Comfortable working in Linux

• Strong interest in robotics, automation, computer vision, or perception

• English proficiency

• Organized and proactive working style

What we offer

• 1000 euro monthly compensation

• 10 vacation days during the internship period

• Flexible working hours and the option to work from home 2 days per week where practical

• A direct and significant influence on highly innovative products

• The opportunity to work close to the hardware and the product, with fast iteration and tight feedback loops

• Full ownership of a self-contained system that the rest of the company will depend on

• A team environment where practical experimentation, learning, and ownership are expected

The application procedure

• If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself. This can be a resume, website, portfolio, or any other source that gives us a clear impression of your background, technical skills, and hands-on experience.

• We will get back to you ASAP. If we think you could be a fit for the position, we will invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a more technically focused interview may follow.

• If at that point we believe you are the person we are looking for, we will discuss the specifics such as starting date and internship period.

Welcome to the team!

data.title: Senior Applied Scientist
data.description:
Meet the team  

You’ll join the Traffic Control Features team within TomTom’s Automated Driving organization. The team builds the technology that turns real-world observations into reliable map information about traffic signs, traffic lights, stop lines and road markings. 

You’ll work with applied scientists and software engineers to develop algorithms and machine-learning solutions that detect, position and connect these features to the right roads and driving directions. The goal is to deliver accurate, scalable map content that supports navigation and advanced driving experiences. TomTom measures these features using quality dimensions such as recall, precision, and road-relation accuracy. 


What you will do:
  • Develop algorithms and ML solutions for traffic signs, traffic lights, road markings, and other traffic-control features, including projects with Computer Vision and Image Recognition.
  • Design and productionize solutions that extract reliable map information from diverse, large-scale and noisy real-world data sources, including car sensor data and unstructured information.
  • Improve how features are detected, positioned, and associated with the correct road/lane and driving direction.
  • Drive measurable improvements in recall, precision, and overall map quality against customer-facing targets.
  • Own components of production pipelines, from input data and feature extraction through evaluation and validated map output.
  • Solve complex problems involving geospatial geometry, map matching, computer vision, image recognition, noisy observations, ground-truth quality, and large-scale evaluation.
  • Run experiments, translate successful approaches into production solutions, and clearly document outcomes.
  • Use AI tools, such as Claude Code, to support problem solving, data analysis, implementation, and engineering productivity.
  • Mentor junior colleagues, provide insightful code reviews, and contribute to hiring. 

    • What you will need:
  • 4+ years of professional experience in Applied Science, Machine Learning, algorithm development, computer vision or related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Geospatial Science, Statistics or another quantitative field. Master’s or PhD is a plus.
  • Strong fundamentals in algorithms and machine learning, including model development, evaluation, statistics and experimental design.
  • Proficiency in Python, an ML framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, and large-scale data processing tools such as Spark or Databricks.
  • Experience taking algorithms, ML models or data pipelines from experimentation into production.
  • Experience leading well-scoped technical projects and mentoring junior colleagues.
  • Ability to work across data, algorithms, modeling, ground truth and evaluation rather than operating within only one area of expertise.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently approach complex and ambiguous problems.
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • You already live in the Netherlands. We cannot offer relocation for this role. 

    •  

    What we offer

    A competitive compensation package, of course.  

    Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. 

    Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.  

    Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.

    Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. 

    Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.  

    Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. 

    Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world. 

    Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom! 

    Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. 


    Meet your team

    We’re Maps, a global team within TomTom’s Location Technology Products technical unit. Our team is driven to deliver the most up-to-date, accurate and detailed maps for hundreds of millions of users around the world. Joining our team, you’ll continuously innovate our mapmaking processes, directly contributing to our vision: engineering the world's most trusted and useful map.


    At TomTom...

    You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.

    Work with a team of 3,300+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them.


    After you apply

    Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs.


    TomTom is an equal opportunity employer

    TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, you. No matter your culture or background, you’ll find your impact at TomTom. Research also shows that sometimes women and underrepresented communities can be hesitant to apply for positions unless they believe they meet 100% of the criteria. If you can relate to this, please know that we’d love to hear from you.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
Principle Software Engineer
Chief Financial Officer
data.description:
Fastned is on a mission to accelerate the transition to electric mobility. Since 2012, we have been building and operating a rapidly growing network of iconic fast-charging stations across Europe powered entirely by solar and wind energy. With 500+ colleagues, we now operate over 450+ stations across nine countries, with an ambitious goal of reaching 1,000 stations by 2030. We are not building infrastructure for its own sake. Every station we open is a tangible step in the transition away from fossil fuels.

We are a listed company on Euronext Amsterdam, with a community of over 10,000 retail investors and a growing base of institutional funding partners. In 2025, we reported €122.4 million in charging revenue: a 47% year-on-year increase, exceeding €100 million in annual revenue for the first time. Fastned is at a pivotal point: growing fast, approaching profitability, and expanding across Europe. As our CFO, you will lead a talented and growing team of 40+ finance professionals to drive and shape Fastned's continued success. 

Your Role 

We are looking for a CFO to join the Management Board, alongside our CEO, COO and CCO, who will drive Fastned on its path to profitability while enabling further growth. 

This role is for a financial leader who thrives in scale-up environments and feels comfortable navigating the complexity of an international matrix organisation. You know how to build a finance function that is both structured and able to move fast, effectively resolving scaling-bottlenecks along the way. You maintain strong financial discipline while enabling the continued investment needed to expand the charging network that supports our long-term vision.

In this role, you oversee the full Finance domain, developing people and teams to the next phase. You act as a key financial voice within the Executive Team and Management Board.

Your responsibilities will include:

Strategic Planning & Partnering: Partner with the Executive Board to set long-term financial goals, evaluate investment opportunities, oversee mergers and acquisitions and direct your teams to deliver the analyses and frameworks that underpin these decisions. 

Manage our capital structure by optimising the company's capital, debt, and equity structure to maximise shareholder value.

Leading the Finance Domain: lead and inspire a talented Finance team of 43 professionals, bringing clear direction, fostering growth in culture that balances a bold mission with financial rigour. With your operational finance expertise, you will empower domain leads to do their best work. For each of your domains this entails the following:

  • Accounting & Reporting team: enabling finance transformation to ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements, ensuring full compliance with applicable regulatory standards and accounting frameworks.

  • Funding & Investor Relations team: develop a compelling, forward-looking equity story that reflects both current performance and long-term potential. You will serve as the primary spokesperson for Fastned's financial health, leading earnings calls and maintaining strong relationships with analysts, shareholders, and investors.

  • Business & Financial Control team: partner with Country- and Functional Directors to evaluate the business cases for new markets, charging stations, joint ventures, and other expansion initiatives, balancing rigorous financial discipline and cost efficiency with growth decisions.

  • Risk & Audit team: build structures that protect against financial fraud and operational risk. Represent the Management Board in Audit Committee meetings and actively drive the implementation and maintenance of internal controls.

  • Tax team: meet tax compliance and the maintenance of a tax control framework across all countries, covering corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and VAT.

  • Serve as the executive owner of Fastned's sustainability strategy, ensuring it is credible, auditable, and aligned with both regulatory requirements, the company's long-term mission.

Management Board Member: Serve as a full member of the Management Board, carrying statutory responsibility for Fastned's financial governance, risk management, sustainability reporting, and knowing when to accelerate growth and when to apply disciplined challenges.

Who we are looking for

  • A financial leader (RA, CPA, CIMA, ACA or equivalent) with proven experience in senior operational finance leadership in scale-up or high-growth environments.

  • A genuine people leader who inspires, challenges, and grows the people around them. 

  • Experience in building and professionalising a scalable finance function, including systems, processes, and team capability including leveraging AI and digital technologies company-wide.

  • Bring a healthy appetite for risk combined with rigorous financial discipline: knowing when to accelerate and when to challenge, driving the business towards profitability while enabling sustainable growth. 

  • Good understanding of funding and capital markets including bonds, equity, project finance, or institutional investment with the ability to tell a compelling and credible financial story to investors.

  • Ability to articulate a long-term financial vision and translate it into clear near-term actions.

  • Affinity with Fastned's mission: a genuine belief in the energy transition.

Join us in building a better future 

We work hard to change the world, but we don't forget to recognise & celebrate our successes, big and small. We put a focus on work-life balance, provide you with genuine work flexibility and have family-friendly policies in place. 

Next to a wide range of attractive secondary benefits, your CFO comps & ben package includes:

  • Annual base compensation between EUR 180.000 and EUR 280.000 (including 8% holiday allowance).

  • You will participate in Fastned’s attractive stock option programmes designed to give you a meaningful opportunity to participate in the long-term value you help create as a member of Fastned’s Management Board.

  • Company-wide Performance Bonus: You are eligible for a discretionary annual bonus with a target of 15% of your annual base salary.

  • 29 holidays. Additionally, you will have 2 ‘Mission Days’ that you can use to contribute to Fastned’s mission or to support a cause that is important to you.

  • Fully electric company car.

Interested in making an impact?

We would love to have a conversation with you and hear why you’re excited about joining Fastned’s mission in this impactful role. Our talent acquisition team will get back to all applicants in due time to share details about timing & structure of the upcoming recruitment process. 

Fastned stands for equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, gender identities, sexual orientations, religions, neurodiversity, disabilities, parental status or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique.

A note to recruitment agencies: we work exclusively with a carefully selected party for this search. Unsolicited agency approaches or candidate submissions will not be considered and do not create any obligation on Fastned's part.

Zo maak je met jouw leiderschap direct impact op besluitvorming, klantbediening én de verdere digitale ontwikkeling van Athora.

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

De Manager Data Customer Engineering rapporteert aan de Director Change & IT Customer Services en geeft leiding aan een team van 10 data engineers en DevOps engineers. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor betrouwbare, herleidbare en bruikbare data voor interne
bedrijfsvoering en sturing, operationele besluitvorming, externe verantwoordingsrapportages en toekomstige AI-toepassingen binnen het Customer Services en Commerce domein. De Manager Data Engineering is verantwoordelijk voor de doorontwikkeling van het huidige
uitvoerende data- en rapportageteam naar een strategisch Data Product Team. De rol versterkt de data engineering capability binnen Customer Services door betrouwbare, herleidbare en AI-ready dataproducten te realiseren voor operationele sturing, besluitvorming, externe verantwoording en toekomstige data en AI-toepassingen. De manager borgt dat data een betrouwbare weergave vormt van businessprocessen en portalen, dat API's een robuuste en betrouwbare brug vormen tussen applicaties, en dat data-delivery plaatsvindt via Agile werkwijzen, schaalbare data engineering, gecontroleerde DevOps-processen en structurele datakwaliteitsborging.


Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Ontwikkelen van het Data Engineering team naar een strategisch Data Product Team met end-to-end eigenaarschap voor betrouwbare en waardevolle dataproducten;

  • Het doorvertalen van de Athora datastrategie binnen Customer Services, inclusief het verhogen van datamanagement maturity en het borgen van data lineage en traceerbaarheid. Hiertoe behoort ook de functionele sturing op de DQ processen, de functionele sturing richting de data stewards om de meting van en verbeteringen in de datakwaliteit vorm te geven;

  • Leveren van betrouwbare, herleidbare, bruikbare en AI-ready data voor interne sturing, operationele besluitvorming, externe verantwoording en toekomstige AI-toepassingen;

  • Borgen van datakwaliteit en een consistente datarepresentatie van businessprocessen, portalen, klantinteracties en operationele ketens binnen Customer Services.


Wat vragen we van jou?

  • WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in informatica, data engineering, data science, informatiemanagement, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • 10-15 jaar ervaring met data engineering, IT delivery, DevOps, applicatieontwikkeling, dataplatformen of digitale transformatie, bij voorkeur in financiele dienstverlening;

  • Ruime ervaring met het aansturen van data engineers, DevOps engineers, IT engineering professionals en/of multidisciplinaire data delivery teams;

  • Ervaring met het realiseren van dataproducten, rapportageketens, data-integraties, operationele stuurinformatie en externe verantwoordingsrapportages;

  • Sterke kennis van data engineering, datamodellering, datavisualisatie, data pipelines, metadata, lineage, datakwaliteit, DevOps, CI/CD, monitoring, cloud, API's, APIM, security-bydesign en beheerbaarheid;

  • Ervaring met .NET-applicaties, integratiemodernisering, ESB-services, API-management, berichtenverkeer, datafundamenten en persoons- of klantadministraties;

  • Ervaring met het vertalen van datastrategie, target architecture en businessprioriteiten naar concrete data roadmaps, technische keuzes en implementatieplannen;

  • Kennis van AI-ready data, verantwoord datagebruik, datagovernance, automatisering en de toepassing van datafundamenten voor toekomstige AI-toepassingen;

  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement richting business, reporting, IT, architectuur, data & AI, security, risk, compliance, leveranciers en senior management;

  • Kennis van wet- en regelgeving, IT risk, privacy, security, datakwaliteit, DORA, EU AI Act en compliance-eisen binnen een gereguleerde omgeving;

  • Ervaring met SAFe Agile standaarden en Agile data-delivery;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

Wij geloven dat onze mensen het verschil maken. Door de kennis en ervaring die zij meebrengen, maar ook door wie zij zijn. Naast de vier Athora kerncompetenties (moed, klantgerichtheid, samenwerken en resultaten leveren) zijn dit de vier belangrijkste competenties voor de Manager:

  • Data Engineering: Data product leiderschap: ontwikkelt visie op betrouwbare, herleidbare en AI-ready dataproducten die waarde creëren voor business, reporting, compliance en toekomstige AI-toepassingen.

  • Executiekracht: vertaalt datastrategie, architectuur en businessbehoeften naar roadmaps, dataproducten en voorspelbare Agile delivery.

  • Engineering mindset: stimuleert vakmanschap, kwaliteit, ownership, DevOps, automatisering, beheerbaarheid en continue verbetering binnen data engineering.

  • Datakwaliteit en control mindset: borgt dat data aantoonbaar betrouwbaar, traceerbaar, gecontroleerd en geschikt is voor besluitvorming, rapportage en verantwoording. Samenwerken met business, pensioenexperts, architectuur, data & AI, security, platformteams en leveranciers, inclusief contracteigenaarschap, contract- en leverancierssturing voor de leveranciers van relevante applicaties en oplossingen.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega’s die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. data.title: Senior Frontend Engineer / Technical Lead
data.description:
Wil jij niet alleen bouwen aan frontendoplossingen, maar ook richting geven aan hoe we onze websites en digitale platformen de komende jaren ontwikkelen?

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Voor ons Websites & Portals Platform team zoeken we een ervaren frontend engineer die technisch leiderschap combineert met sterke hands-on kennis van Angular. Iemand die vooruitkijkt, een frontend visie en roadmap kan neerzetten en andere teams kan meenemen in de technische richting.
Je bent dus niet alleen degene die complexe frontend vraagstukken kan oplossen. Je helpt ook bepalen waar we naartoe gaan, welke technische keuzes we maken en hoe verschillende ontwikkelteams binnen die koers samenwerken.

Als Senior Frontend Engineer / Technical Lead speel je een centrale rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van ons frontend platform.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

- het opstellen en uitdragen van de technische visie en roadmap voor frontend;
- het verder ontwikkelen en moderniseren van het frontend platform;
- het ontwikkelen van herbruikbare platformcomponenten voor onze websites en digitale klantomgevingen;
- het maken en bewaken van technische en architectuurkeuzes;
- hands-on ontwikkelen met Angular en TypeScript;
- het inhoudelijk richting geven aan developers en ontwikkelteams die gebruikmaken van het platform;
- het bewaken van standaarden, kwaliteit, onderhoudbaarheid en samenhang;
- het vertalen van behoeften vanuit verschillende teams naar toekomstbestendige technische oplossingen;
- samenwerken met onder andere solution teams, architectuur, security en infrastructuur.

Het gaat daarmee om meer dan software ontwikkelen. Jij helpt de technische koers van het frontendlandschap te bepalen en zorgt ervoor dat die koers ook daadwerkelijk landt binnen de organisatie. Wat deze rol interessant maakt? Je krijgt de kans om op meerdere niveaus impact te maken. De ene keer duik je zelf de techniek in. De andere keer bespreek je een architectuurkeuze, werk je aan de roadmap of help je een ander team om een oplossing binnen het platform goed neer te zetten. Daarbij kijk je verder dan het individuele vraagstuk. Je vraagt je steeds af: hoe maken we het platform eenvoudiger, consistenter, schaalbaarder en toekomstbestendiger?

#LI-DNI


Wat vragen we van jou?

We zoeken nadrukkelijk een ervaren frontendprofessional die technische diepgang weet te combineren met visie en leiderschap.

Je hebt:
- ruime ervaring met frontendontwikkeling;
- diepgaande ervaring met Angular en TypeScript;
- ervaring met NX workspace / monorepo en NodeJS, of vergelijkbare moderne frontendomgevingen;
- ervaring met Azure App Service en Azure Pipelines, of vergelijkbare cloud- en CI/CD-omgevingen;
- ervaring met het ontwerpen en doorontwikkelen van frontendplatformen;
- het vermogen om een technische visie en roadmap op te stellen en uit te dragen;

- ervaring met Agile, Scrum en/of SAFe;
- minimaal hbo-werk- en denkniveau;
- een goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels en woonachtig in Nederland.

Wie ben jij? Je bent technisch sterk, maar bent niet iemand die het liefst alleen met code bezig is.

- Je ziet afhankelijkheden tussen teams en systemen;

- Je kunt ontwikkelteams enthousiasmeren en meenemen;

Je combineert daarmee de kwaliteiten van een senior engineer, technisch sparringpartner en kartrekker.

data.title: Project Manager - Data & Analytics
data.description:
Adaptfy is growing! We are looking for a Project Management Associate with 5+ years of experience, to join our Data and Analytics team in Amsterdam.


Who we are

Adaptfy is a turnkey data & analytics solution for the SHV family of companies. We support multiple SHV Groups with advanced Data & Analytics in all areas, elevating their operations in diverse industries across international markets and throughout entire value chains.

Adaptfy is a joint venture formed by SHV and Metyis. Metyis embodies visionary thinking in the digital world, while SHV is a globally established family of companies built on the values of integrity, trust, curiosity, passion, and inclusivity.

 SHV has a presence across four continents, with businesses spanning energy, heavy lifting and transport, animal nutrition & aquaculture, testing, inspection & certification, and more. The organisation’s history reflects its courage to care—for people, for performance, and for future generations. Their success is a testament to constant reinvention through innovation.

 At Adaptfy, we play a pivotal role in bringing SHV’s digital vision to life. From optimising supply chains across Europe to enhancing operational efficiency in South America, we connect the dots for SHV, shaping a data-driven future for the entire family of companies.

What we offer

  • Opportunity to accelerate digital growth and business transformation through AI, Data & Analytics, Digital Commerce, advanced technologies, and strategic business solutions.

  • Driving high-impact insights & enhancing decision making across the organization.

  • Driving brand equity and digital sales through enhanced digital experiences.

  • Interaction with senior business (and/or ecommerce) leaders on regular basis to drive their business towards impactful change.

  • Become part of a fast growing international and diverse team

     

What you will do

  • Support the successful delivery of client engagements across Digital Transformation, Technology, Data & AI, Digital Commerce, Customer Experience, and Business Transformation initiatives.

  • Manage assigned workstreams or smaller projects, ensuring delivery against agreed scope, timelines, quality, and budget.

  • Develop and maintain project plans, delivery schedules, RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), status reports, and project documentation.

  • Monitor project progress, identify delivery risks and dependencies, and proactively escalate issues where required.

  • Coordinate project activities across multidisciplinary teams to ensure effective execution and delivery.

  • Build strong working relationships with client stakeholders, project teams, and internal delivery functions.

  • Support governance activities including project reporting, steering committee preparation, action tracking, and decision management.

  • Facilitate project meetings, workshops, sprint ceremonies, and status reviews.

  • Ensure clear communication of project progress, milestones, risks, issues, and decisions to relevant stakeholders.

  • Support change management and business readiness activities throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Business Technology consultants, Scrum Masters, Architects, Engineers, Designers, and client stakeholders to coordinate successful delivery.

  • Contribute to Agile delivery by supporting sprint planning, backlog reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and dependency management.

  • Ensure project deliverables comply with agreed governance, quality standards, and delivery methodologies.

  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, project governance, and team collaboration.

  • Support proposal development, project planning activities, and internal capability initiatives where required.

  • Travel as required to support client engagements.

What you will bring

  • 5+ years of experience in Project Management, PMO, Delivery Management, Consulting, Digital Transformation, Technology Delivery, or related roles.

  • Experience supporting or managing projects within Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery environments.

  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams across business and technology functions.

  • Good understanding of Project Management principles including planning, governance, scheduling, RAID management, dependency management, budgeting, and reporting.

  • Experience developing project plans, status reports, delivery dashboards, and governance artefacts.

  • Ability to coordinate multiple workstreams while maintaining delivery quality and stakeholder alignment.

  • Understanding of project lifecycle management from initiation through delivery and project closure.

  • Understanding of Digital Transformation, Technology, Data & AI, Digital Commerce, Customer Experience, or Enterprise Technology initiatives.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.

  • Good analytical and structured problem-solving skills.

  • Experience working collaboratively within cross-functional consulting and delivery teams.

  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to prepare project reports and executive-ready updates.

  • Experience facilitating project meetings, workshops, and delivery governance sessions.

  • Comfortable working with business stakeholders, delivery teams, and client leadership.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related discipline.

  • Professional proficiency in English.

  • Willingness to travel based on client and project requirements.

  • Experience delivering Digital Transformation, Enterprise Applications, Digital Commerce, Data & AI, Cloud, ERP, CRM, Customer Experience, or Enterprise Platform programmes.

  • Familiarity with Agile delivery frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid project delivery methodologies.

  • Experience using project delivery tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project, Confluence, Planner, Smartsheet, Monday.com, or similar collaboration platforms.

  • Foundation certifications in Project Management (PRINCE2 Foundation, PMP, CAPM), Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or Change Management.

  • Awareness of PMO governance, financial tracking, resource planning, and portfolio reporting.

  • Knowledge of Dutch or additional European languages is advantageous depending on client engagements.

We are united by our differences

At Metyis, we are driven by curiosity and collaboration. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) in all its forms as it makes us stronger as an organisation and promotes creativity and innovation. We welcome all talents and are committed to creating a workplace where every employee can make a meaningful impact and grow.

Metyis only contacts candidates through verified and official channels: LinkedIn (official and verified recruiter profiles), emails ending in @metyis.com, and our Applicant Tracking System (Recruitee). data.title: International Expansion - Netherlands
data.description:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the Dutch market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results in the Dutch market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

  • Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

  • Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and eventually on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

  • Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

  • Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

  • Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to deliver first-of-a-kind projects in one of Europe’s most important flexibility markets, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in the Netherlands. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

data.title: Junior or Medior AI Engineer
data.description:
HelloPrint is rebuilding the entire platform: new frontend, new pricing engine, new content engine, new product engine, everything ready for an agentic future. No one on the team writes code manually for what these systems handle. You'll work inside this rebuild, under the direction of our founding team (Hans, CEO, and Michael, CIO/Chief AI Officer), executing on high-leverage AI problems with real commercial impact, visible immediately in revenue or cost. There's no management layer between you and the outcome. You build, you ship, you measure, you move to the next problem.

What you will build:

The opportunity surface is large: 14 markets, 600,000 customers, a platform being rebuilt in parallel across four core engines. You'll work on problems from areas like:

  • Dynamic pricing and margin optimization across markets.

  • Agentic procurement: supplier selection, ordering, quality management.

  • Customer journey automation from configuration to post-delivery.

  • Intelligent content and SEO infrastructure at platform scale.

  • Predictive demand and inventory across the supplier network.

  • Internal tooling that multiplies the output of every team.

Before you read further

HelloPrint is on a mission to become the world's leading infrastructure for customizable printed products. From our offices in Rotterdam and Valencia, 100+ professionals from 20+ nationalities are building an AI-first company that scales output faster than headcount. We're at EUR 100M revenue and aiming to disrupt a trillion-dollar industry. Every hire we make needs to help get us there.

  • Commercial instinct first, engineering second. You think about what something is worth before you think about how to build it.

  • Full-time in Rotterdam. Five days a week, in the building where the transformation is happening.

  • You have been building since before it was a career. Side projects, tools, systems nobody asked for. The obsession came first.

  • You ship continuously. You ship fast and you ship real systems. Not prototypes, not demos.

  • You are more than just an engineer. You understand product decisions, user impact, and design tradeoffs. You do not need a PM to translate the business problem for you.


Who you are:

You've built and shipped real production systems, not just contributed to someone else's. You're comfortable with ambiguity and don't need a fully specified brief to start. You care about what your work is worth, not just whether it works. You want to build inside a company that's already proven, not another 0-to-1 bet. You do not think of yourself as an AI engineer. You think of yourself as someone who solves hard problems and builds the systems to prove it. The engineering is the method. The obsession is the identity.

Three signals that tell us you are that person:

  • You've spotted an opportunity for an AI solution before anyone assigned it to you, and built it, even if it started as a side project or a shortcut nobody asked for. Ask you to name one and it won't take you long.

  • What you've shipped has been in production and actually used, not a prototype sitting in a repo or a demo that impressed someone once.

  • You can point to at least one thing you built where you had a rough idea of what it was worth before building it, and checked afterward whether it delivered.

Must-haves:

  • Hands-on production experience, not purely architectural or supervisory.

  • Commercial instinct that precedes technical execution: you know the business case before you write the first line.

  • Track record of shipping production AI/software systems that are live and used by real users.

  • Solid fluency in LLMs, agentic workflows, and modern AI infrastructure.

  • Ability to reason about commercial impact, not just technical correctness.

  • Comfortable working with high autonomy and limited process.

  • Office-first: on-site in Rotterdam, five days a week.



This role is not for you if you:

This role is not for people who got into AI because it became important. It is for people who have been building since before anyone called it a career. The kind of person who coded as a teenager, shipped their first thing before anyone asked, and has never really stopped. Who finds it genuinely difficult to explain why they build: it is just what they do. Who would rather spend a Sunday solving a hard systems problem than almost anything else. If you have to think about whether that description fits you, it probably does not.

  • Got into AI because it became an important skill, not because you could not imagine doing anything else.

  • Need a brief, a PM, or a defined scope before taking action.

  • Measure your output in technical quality or feature count rather than business impact.

  • Would answer 'what would you build first?' with an infrastructure question.

  • If you think a workweek of 40h is a lot.

  • Prefer hybrid or remote working.

What we offer

  • 🎯 Room to grow: opportunities develop fast, within your role and across HelloPrint

  • 🌍 The team: 100+ people from 20+ nationalities who build at a pace most companies cannot match. Rotterdam is not a compromise. It is where the work happens.

  • 🚀 Real impact: shape the future of a high-growth, AI-driven company where your ideas land in production the same week.

  • 💡 Full autonomy from day one: no roadmap to follow, no brief to wait for. You see the problem, you build the solution, you own the outcome.
